justification: Correct: the WBS hierarchically decomposes the entire project scope into manageable work packages.

text: A project manager must determine the total project duration accounting for dependencies between activities. Which technique calculates project duration and identifies the critical path?

options.A: Earned value management (EVM)
options.B: The affinity diagram
options.C: The Critical Path Method (CPM)
options.D: SWOT analysis

justification: Correct: the Critical Path Method (CPM) calculates the minimum project duration by identifying the longest sequence of activities with no float.

text: An agile team uses a Kanban board and finds a recurring bottleneck in the 'Test' column. Which Lean/Kanban action is most appropriate?

options.A: Ignore the bottleneck and keep adding upstream work
options.B: Completely remove the testing step to speed up the flow
options.C: Indefinitely increase the backlog size
options.D: Set a work-in-progress (WIP) limit on the Test column and analyze the bottleneck's causes with the team

justification: Correct: setting a WIP limit forces the team to resolve the bottleneck before adding new work, a fundamental Kanban/Lean flow principle.

text: A project manager wants to anticipate potential risks before they occur. Which qualitative technique is commonly used to assess probability and impact of identified risks?

options.A: The probability-impact matrix
options.B: The burndown chart
options.C: The Kanban board
options.D: The Gantt chart

justification: Correct: the probability-impact matrix allows a rapid qualitative assessment of risks to prioritize those requiring a response.

text: A project manager must establish a baseline to track project performance. What does the performance measurement baseline typically include?

options.A: The approved scope, schedule, and cost baselines, integrated for performance measurement
options.B: Only the list of identified risks
options.C: Only meeting minutes
options.D: Only the total project budget

justification: Correct: the performance measurement baseline (PMB) integrates approved scope, schedule, and cost baselines, used for earned value analysis.

text: A Scrum team wants to improve delivery predictability. Which agile metric is most useful for forecasting future sprint delivery capacity?

options.A: The average velocity of recent sprints
options.B: The total number of open bugs
options.C: The number of hours physically present at the office
options.D: The number of meetings held per sprint

justification: Correct: the average velocity of previous sprints is the standard empirical metric to forecast future delivery capacity.

text: A project manager must select the least risky schedule compression method to catch up on a delay without significantly increasing costs. Which technique is most appropriate if activities can run in parallel without major risk?

options.A: Reducing scope without consultation
options.B: Crashing (adding resources)
options.C: Fast-tracking (overlapping activities)
options.D: Stopping the project

justification: Correct: fast-tracking consists of executing normally sequential activities in parallel, without major additional cost, when risk allows.

text: A project manager must guarantee that scope changes are properly controlled. Which document serves as the reference for evaluating whether a request truly constitutes a change?

options.A: The weekly progress report
options.B: Team members' resumes
options.C: The organization chart
options.D: The scope statement and the approved scope baseline

justification: Correct: any request is compared against the approved scope baseline to determine whether it constitutes a deviation requiring a formal change request.

text: In a hybrid project, certain regulatory requirements demand exhaustive documentation while development happens in agile sprints. How can the two be reconciled?

options.A: Fully abandon the agile approach in favor of complete documentation
options.B: Defer all documentation to the very end of the project
options.C: Integrate regulatory documentation as an acceptance criterion ('Definition of Done') for the relevant user stories, produced progressively at each sprint
options.D: Ignore regulatory requirements to keep pace with sprint deadlines

justification: Correct: integrating regulatory documentation into the Definition of Done allows compliant, incremental production without sacrificing agility.

text: A project manager must verify that work performed meets quality standards before delivery to the client. Which process consists of inspecting the product to verify its conformance?

options.A: Develop Project Charter
options.B: Plan Resource Management
options.C: Manage Quality
options.D: Control Quality

justification: Correct: Control Quality involves monitoring and recording the results of executing quality activities to verify deliverable conformance.

text: A project manager must choose an indicator to forecast the final estimated project cost accounting for current performance. Which EVM indicator meets this need?

options.A: Actual Cost (AC) alone
options.B: Earned Value (EV) alone
options.C: Estimate at Completion (EAC)
options.D: Planned Value (PV)

justification: Correct: EAC forecasts the project's final total cost accounting for current performance (CPI) and costs already incurred.

text: A project manager receives an official claim from a supplier regarding the interpretation of a contractual clause. Which procurement management process handles this type of situation?

options.A: Develop Team
options.B: Plan Procurement Management
options.C: Identify Risks
options.D: Control Procurements, including managing contractual claims

justification: Correct: the Control Procurements process includes managing contractual relationships and handling claims administration.

text: An agile team must decide how to manage accumulated technical debt that progressively slows velocity. Which practice is most recommended?

options.A: Allocate a regular share of sprint capacity to reducing technical debt, made visible in the backlog
options.B: Stop all feature development for six months to refactor everything
options.C: Ignore technical debt as long as features are delivered
options.D: Transfer responsibility for technical debt to the client

justification: Correct: allocating a regular capacity share to technical debt, made visible and prioritized in the backlog, is the recommended sustainable practice.

text: A project manager must anticipate the cumulative impact of many individually minor but numerous risks. Which quantitative analysis technique is most appropriate?

options.A: Brainstorming
options.B: SWOT analysis only
options.C: Monte Carlo simulation
options.D: The affinity diagram

justification: Correct: Monte Carlo simulation models the cumulative effect of multiple uncertainties to estimate a probabilistic distribution of outcomes (cost/schedule).

text: A project manager must formalize the initial agreement authorizing the project and naming the project manager. Which document is required?

options.A: The stakeholder register
options.B: The Project Charter
options.C: The cost management plan
options.D: The closure report

justification: Correct: the project charter formally authorizes the project and names the project manager with their level of authority.

text: A Scrum team wants to visualize its progress trend within a sprint. Which visual tool is most suitable?

options.A: The RACI matrix
options.B: The Pareto diagram
options.C: The Gantt chart
options.D: The sprint burndown chart

justification: Correct: the sprint burndown chart visualizes remaining work relative to elapsed sprint time, a standard agile tracking tool.

text: A project manager must close a project phase before moving to the next. What action is essential before this transition?

options.A: Reduce the next phase's budget with no justification
options.B: Obtain formal acceptance of the phase's deliverables and document lessons learned
options.C: Ignore unfinished deliverables of the current phase
options.D: Move directly to the next phase without validation

justification: Correct: phase closure requires formal acceptance of deliverables and capitalizing on lessons learned before moving to the next phase (phase review/gate review).

text: A project manager must evaluate the impact of a major exchange rate fluctuation on an international project financed in a foreign currency. Which enterprise environmental factor (EEF) is concerned?

options.A: Marketplace conditions and external economic factors
options.B: The project manager's management style
options.C: The software tools used by the team
options.D: Internal organizational culture

justification: Correct: currency fluctuations and marketplace conditions are external EEFs to monitor and integrate into risk management.

text: A company evaluates several candidate projects with limited budgets. Which financial method allows comparing the relative profitability of projects of different sizes?

options.A: The number of employees assigned to the project
options.B: Net Present Value (NPV) only in absolute value
options.C: The project duration only
options.D: Internal Rate of Return (IRR) or benefit-cost ratio, which normalize comparison regardless of size

justification: Correct: IRR or benefit-cost ratio normalize profitability as a percentage or ratio, allowing fair comparison between projects of different sizes.

text: An organization wants to assess whether its culture is open enough to support a large-scale agile transformation. Which cultural factor is most determinant?

options.A: The size of the physical offices
options.B: Tolerance for failure, trust in teams, and openness to decentralized decision-making
options.C: The number of digital tools available
options.D: The number of certifications held by employees

justification: Correct: a durable agile culture relies on tolerance for failure (learning), trust, and decentralized decision-making, fundamental cultural elements.

text: A project manager must ensure the project respects the organization's information security policy when processing sensitive customer data. What action is a priority?

options.A: Wait for a security incident before acting
options.B: Integrate information security requirements into the project management plan and consult the security/compliance team early in planning
options.C: Process sensitive data without any particular protection measure
options.D: Ignore the policy if it slows the project

justification: Correct: security requirements must be integrated from planning, in consultation with relevant security/compliance experts.

text: A company measures the success of its initiatives via an OKR (Objectives and Key Results) framework rather than a traditional project plan. What is the main advantage of this framework in an agile context?

options.A: It completely eliminates the need to measure performance
options.B: It aligns teams on measurable, ambitious objectives while leaving flexibility on the means (the 'how')
options.C: It completely replaces the need for communication between teams
options.D: It imposes a rigid detailed 12-month plan

justification: Correct: OKRs align teams on measurable key results while preserving autonomy on how to achieve them, consistent with the agile spirit.

text: A project manager notices a competitor just launched a similar product, threatening the strategic relevance of the ongoing project. What is the best action?

options.A: Inform governance and reassess the business case to adjust project strategy if necessary (differentiation, acceleration)
options.B: Completely ignore the competitive threat
options.C: Immediately copy the competitor's product without analysis
options.D: Stop the project without consulting governance

justification: Correct: the PM must escalate to governance and reassess the business case to adjust strategy (differentiation, schedule acceleration, etc.).

text: An organization wants to assess the value delivered by its digital product beyond internal production metrics. Which type of external indicator is most relevant?

options.A: The number of code commits
options.B: The number of internal meetings held
options.C: Net Promoter Score (NPS) and user adoption/retention rates
options.D: The number of user stories created

justification: Correct: NPS and adoption/retention rates directly measure user satisfaction and perceived value, key external indicators of product success.

text: A project manager must integrate corporate social responsibility (CSR) requirements into a construction project. Which action best illustrates this integration?

options.A: Integrate CSR criteria (environmental impact, fair labor conditions) into vendor selection criteria and the project management plan
options.B: Ignore CSR if it slightly increases costs
options.C: Fully delegate CSR to the marketing department with no link to project execution
options.D: Treat CSR as optional with no impact on project decisions

justification: Correct: integrating concrete CSR criteria into vendor selection and the project management plan is the practice aligned with professional and societal responsibility.

text: A project manager must gain buy-in from a skeptical sponsor regarding the value of an enhanced risk management methodology. Which negotiation and influence approach is most effective?

options.A: Present concrete data (costs avoided, similar project examples) demonstrating the added value of the proposed approach
options.B: Bypass the sponsor and implement the method without their approval
options.C: Immediately abandon the idea in the face of skepticism
options.D: Impose the method without justification

justification: Correct: evidence-based influence (return on investment, benchmarks) is the most effective technique to convince a skeptical decision-maker.

text: A Scrum Master notices the team systematically blames external factors for problems without ever examining its own practices. What intervention fosters a culture of accountability?

options.A: Confirm that problems always come from outside
options.B: Publicly blame the team for its lack of accountability
options.C: Use retrospective techniques focused on what the team actually controls (circle of influence) to refocus on possible internal actions
options.D: Ignore the blame pattern

justification: Correct: refocusing the retrospective on the team's 'circle of influence' helps identify concrete internal actions, fostering accountability.

text: The project manager must guarantee traceability between the initial requirements and the final deliverables. Which tool ensures this traceability?

options.A: The risk register
options.B: The Gantt chart
options.C: The Kanban board
options.D: The Requirements Traceability Matrix

justification: Correct: the Requirements Traceability Matrix links each requirement to its origin, deliverables, and acceptance tests, ensuring complete coverage.

text: An agile team wants to continuously improve code quality. Which agile engineering practice best supports early defect detection?

options.A: Continuous integration with automated tests at every commit
options.B: Reduce delivery frequency to limit needed testing
options.C: Test only at the end of each major release
options.D: Never automate tests to maintain full manual control

justification: Correct: continuous integration with automated tests detects defects as early as possible, reducing correction cost and improving continuous quality.

text: A project manager wants to systematically identify all potential stakeholders before the project starts. Which process covers this activity?

options.A: Control Costs
options.B: Identify Stakeholders
options.C: Acquire Resources
options.D: Close Project

justification: Correct: the 'Identify Stakeholders' process systematically catalogs individuals and organizations impacted by or impacting the project.

text: A project manager must decide how often to update the risk register. What is the best practice?

options.A: Only if a risk materializes
options.B: Only once, during initial planning
options.C: Review and update the risk register regularly throughout the project, particularly during status meetings
options.D: Only at project closure

justification: Correct: risk management is iterative; the register must be reviewed regularly to integrate new risks and the evolution of existing ones.

text: A project manager learns that a team member accepted a significantly valuable gift from a supplier during an active tender process. What is the appropriate action per the PMI Code of Ethics?

options.A: Resolve the matter privately with no documentation
options.B: Encourage the practice if it benefits the project
options.C: Treat the situation as a potential conflict of interest, document it, and apply the organization's compliance policy
options.D: Ignore it if the gift didn't influence the decision

justification: Correct: the PMI Code of Ethics requires transparency and rigorous management of conflicts of interest, with formal documentation and application of the compliance policy.

text: An organization wants to move from siloed project management to continuous product-centric management for its digital platforms. Which structural organizational change generally accompanies this transition?

options.A: Forming permanent, cross-functional product teams aligned with long-term business value
options.B: Returning to a strictly functional hierarchical structure
options.C: Maintaining temporary projects with teams dissolved at every project end
options.D: Total removal of all governance

justification: Correct: the transition to product management involves permanent, cross-functional teams organized around durable business value rather than one-off projects.

text: A project manager must evaluate if the project remains viable after a major shift in company strategic direction. Which governance action is appropriate?

options.A: Conduct a formal strategic alignment review with portfolio governance to decide on continuation, adjustment, or termination
options.B: Decide alone to stop the project
options.C: Continue the project without reassessment
options.D: Ignore the change in strategic direction

justification: Correct: a major strategic change requires a formal portfolio governance review to determine the project's future.

text: A Product Owner wants to maximize delivered value with a limited budget for the next quarter. Which backlog ordering technique best reflects a combined cost-value-urgency reasoning?

options.A: Weighted Shortest Job First (WSJF), integrating business value, urgency, risk, and effort size
options.B: Alphabetical sorting of user stories
options.C: Order of addition to the backlog (strict FIFO)
options.D: Random priority choice

justification: Correct: WSJF combines business value, urgency, risk reduction, and effort size to maximize value delivered per unit of time, particularly useful under budget constraint.

text: A project manager must decide what type of diagram to use to visually represent the cause-and-effect relationships of a recurring quality problem. Which tool is most appropriate?

options.A: The RACI matrix
options.B: The Ishikawa diagram (fishbone diagram)
options.C: The Gantt chart
options.D: The Kanban board

justification: Correct: the Ishikawa diagram (cause-and-effect) visually structures the potential causes of a quality problem by category (manpower, method, material, etc.).

text: A project manager evaluates whether to invest in a new system while an existing system still functions, but with rising maintenance costs. Which financial analysis helps compare the two options over their full lifetime?

options.A: The warranty duration of the new system only
options.B: Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis
options.C: Calculation of the initial purchase price only
options.D: The number of employees trained on the current system

justification: Correct: TCO integrates all costs over the full lifecycle (acquisition, maintenance, operation, end-of-life), enabling a rigorous financial comparison between options.

text: A project manager notices two key team members have very different communication styles (one direct and factual, the other more relational and indirect), causing frequent misunderstandings. What action fosters better collaboration?

options.A: Ask one of the two to completely change their natural style
options.B: Raise mutual awareness of communication style differences and establish explicit team norms for key exchanges
options.C: Ignore the misunderstandings as long as they don't block the project
options.D: Permanently separate them to avoid any contact

justification: Correct: mutual awareness of communication styles and explicit team norms durably reduce misunderstandings.

text: An organization evaluates the agile maturity of its teams before a major investment in a scaled agile tooling platform. What factor is most determinant to justify this investment?

options.A: The lowest price of the tool, regardless of fit
options.B: The IT director's personal preference for a particular tool
options.C: The number of marketing features of the tool
options.D: A cost-benefit analysis accounting for cross-team coordination gains and organization-wide product visibility

justification: Correct: a scaled tooling investment decision should be based on a genuine cost-benefit analysis integrating expected organizational gains.

text: A Scrum Master notices the team consistently achieves stable velocity but member satisfaction is declining. Which hypothesis and priority action are most relevant?

options.A: Replace dissatisfied members
options.B: Increase the target velocity to compensate
options.C: Explore the causes of declining satisfaction (sense of purpose, recognition, perceived workload) through individual conversations and targeted retrospectives
options.D: Stable velocity means everything is fine; no action needed

justification: Correct: declining satisfaction despite stable velocity requires deep human exploration (purpose, recognition, perceived workload) to prevent future disengagement.

text: A project manager is asked by a business partner to share confidential information about a competitor obtained by mistake. What is the correct action per the PMI Code of Ethics?

options.A: Use the information to negotiate a personal advantage
options.B: Refuse to share the inappropriately obtained confidential information and address the situation per the principles of honesty and fairness
options.C: Share the information secretly with no notification
options.D: Share the information if it benefits the project

justification: Correct: the PMI Code of Ethics requires refusing to use inappropriately obtained information and handling the situation with transparency and integrity.

text: A Scrum Master notices a team member consistently takes on more work than they can complete out of fear of disappointing others. What is the best intervention?

options.A: Ignore it, it's not the Scrum Master's role
options.B: Let them continue since it shows commitment
options.C: Publicly reduce their workload in front of the team to force change
options.D: Discuss privately about realistic workload, encourage transparency about capacity, and reinforce that it's acceptable to say no

justification: Correct: a private, caring conversation reinforces psychological safety and helps the person honestly express their real capacity.

text: A project manager must decide how to manage a management reserve distinct from the contingency reserve. Who generally has the authority to approve the use of the management reserve?

options.A: The primary supplier
options.B: The sponsor or governance, since it covers unidentified risks (unknown-unknowns) outside the PM's direct control
options.C: Any team member
options.D: The project manager alone, with no approval

justification: Correct: the management reserve covers unidentified risks and its use generally requires sponsor or governance approval.

text: An organization notices its agile teams quickly produce features, but end-user adoption remains low. What is the most likely cause to investigate first?

options.A: A misalignment between the backlog's value hypotheses and users' real needs, requiring more user discovery
options.B: The Scrum Master isn't facilitating enough ceremonies
options.C: The team isn't using enough digital tools
options.D: The team isn't working enough hours

justification: Correct: low adoption despite rapid delivery often signals a misalignment between what's being built and real needs, requiring more user research and hypothesis validation.

text: A project manager must decide on the level of involvement of secondary stakeholders with high interest but low power. Which power/interest matrix strategy is appropriate?

options.A: Keep Informed
options.B: Completely ignore them
options.C: Manage them closely with the same intensity as high-power stakeholders
options.D: Give them final decision authority

justification: Correct: for high interest and low power, the 'Keep Informed' strategy involves regularly providing information without requiring intensive management.

text: A project manager must ensure the allocated budget precisely matches the planned workload over time. Which tool combines schedule and cost for this planning?

options.A: The Kanban board
options.B: The affinity diagram
options.C: The Ishikawa diagram
options.D: The S-curve (time-phased budget)

justification: Correct: the S-curve represents the cumulative budget time-phased across the project, serving as the baseline for earned value analysis.

text: A project must comply with strict environmental standards imposed by an international donor. Which action best guarantees continuous compliance?

options.A: Only document compliance upon explicit request
options.B: Integrate environmental compliance indicators into periodic reports and the donor's review milestones
options.C: Verify compliance only at the time of final disbursement
options.D: Ignore the donor's requirements if they slow execution

justification: Correct: integrating compliance indicators into periodic reports and milestones guarantees the continuous tracking expected by institutional donors.

text: A junior Product Owner lacks confidence to make difficult prioritization decisions and systematically escalates to their manager. What action best supports their development?

options.A: Make the prioritization decisions on their behalf
options.B: Report their lack of competence to leadership for replacement
options.C: Coach the PO on prioritization techniques and gradually build their decision-making autonomy, reinforcing their legitimacy with management
options.D: Ignore the situation since it's not the team's problem

justification: Correct: progressive coaching and reinforcing the PO's legitimacy with management builds durable autonomy.

text: A project manager observes a significant deviation between actual cost and budgeted cost for a completed activity. Which indicator precisely measures this deviation?

options.A: Schedule Performance Index (SPI)
options.B: Total Float
options.C: Cost Variance (CV = EV - AC)
options.D: Schedule Variance (SV)

justification: Correct: Cost Variance (CV = EV - AC) directly measures the difference between earned value and actual cost spent for the work performed.

text: An organization adopting agility wants to establish lightweight but effective governance for its digital products. Which mechanism is most suitable?

options.A: Regular product reviews based on value metrics and OKRs, with rapid escalation in case of drift
options.B: Hierarchical validation for every minor technical decision
options.C: A monthly steering committee with an exhaustive 100-page document review
options.D: No governance at all

justification: Correct: regular reviews based on value metrics and OKRs, with rapid escalation, offer light but effective governance suited to agility.

text: The project manager observes that an unresolved conflict between two departments is negatively affecting the project team's morale. What is the best first step?

options.A: Resign from the project manager role
options.B: Take sides with one department against the other
options.C: Facilitate a structured discussion between the department heads to clarify the issues and seek common ground
options.D: Ignore the conflict since it's external to the project

justification: Correct: the PM should proactively facilitate a structured resolution even for inter-departmental conflicts affecting their project.

text: A team working in Kanban wants to reduce its average cycle time. Which action is most directly effective?

options.A: Add more validation steps to the process
options.B: Increase the number of items in progress simultaneously
options.C: Reduce work-in-progress (WIP) limits and eliminate identified bottlenecks in the flow
options.D: Ignore flow measurements

justification: Correct: reducing WIP limits forces resolution of bottlenecks and improves flow, thereby decreasing average cycle time (Kanban/Lean principle).

text: An international project manager must manage a team including members from high power-distance cultures. Which communication adaptation is recommended?

options.A: Require systematic public challenge of authority
options.B: Treat all members strictly the same, with no regard for cultural context
options.C: Be aware these members may hesitate to openly contradict a superior and create safe spaces to express concerns (e.g., anonymous feedback)
options.D: Completely ignore cultural differences

justification: Correct: in high power-distance cultures, offering alternative channels (anonymous feedback, private discussions) helps surface concerns that wouldn't be expressed publicly.

text: A Scrum Master notices an introverted team member has valuable ideas but never shares them in group meetings. Which facilitation practice best helps collect their contribution?

options.A: Ignore them since they don't voluntarily speak up
options.B: Ask another member to speak on their behalf without consulting them
options.C: Force them to speak publicly in front of the whole team
options.D: Use silent brainwriting techniques before oral discussion and offer individual channels (1:1, written) for sharing ideas

justification: Correct: silent brainwriting and individual channels let introverted profiles contribute without the pressure of immediate public speaking.

text: A project manager must check whether the project's initial assumptions remain valid at the midpoint. Which document should be consulted and updated?

options.A: The Assumption Log
options.B: The supplier contract only
options.C: The cost management plan only
options.D: Team members' resumes

justification: Correct: the assumption log documents initial assumptions and constraints and must be regularly reviewed to verify their continued validity.

text: A rapidly growing company wants to scale its agile organization from 3 to 15 teams in a year. Which major organizational risk should be anticipated first?

options.A: The risk that Scrum ceremonies become too short
options.B: Loss of product coherence and cross-team communication without an adapted coordination framework (e.g., Scrum of Scrums, architectural alignment)
options.C: No particular risk; agility automatically scales to any size
options.D: The risk that teams become too small

justification: Correct: rapid growth in the number of teams without a coordination mechanism (Scrum of Scrums, guilds, architectural alignment) risks fragmenting product coherence and communication.

text: A project manager must evaluate the individual performance of team members at project end. Which human resources practice is most appropriate and ethical?

options.A: Use objective performance criteria, documented regularly throughout the project, and provide balanced, constructive feedback
options.B: Never evaluate individual performance
options.C: Evaluate solely based on undocumented subjective impressions
options.D: Publicly compare everyone's performance in front of the whole team

justification: Correct: continuously documented objective criteria, combined with balanced constructive feedback, ensure a fair evaluation useful for professional development.

text: A project manager must choose between two schedule compression options while the budget is very limited. Which option should be prioritized?

options.A: Fast-tracking, which overlaps activities with no significant additional cost
options.B: Crashing, which adds paid additional resources
options.C: Doubling the team with no cost analysis
options.D: Outsourcing the entire project to a new supplier

justification: Correct: fast-tracking reduces duration with no significant additional cost by executing certain activities in parallel, suited to a tight budget constraint.

text: The project manager learns that part of the project's funding comes from public funds subject to strict transparency and audit rules. Which practice is essential?

options.A: Rigorously document all expenditures and decisions to be ready for an audit at any time
options.B: Only share financial information upon explicit request from the donor
options.C: Avoid documenting certain expenditures to speed up the process
options.D: Consider transparency rules as optional

justification: Correct: public funding requires rigorous, continuous documentation of expenditures and decisions to guarantee transparency and audit readiness.

text: An external (consultant) Scrum Master joins an existing team and perceives initial distrust from members toward their role. Which approach best builds trust?

options.A: First observe existing dynamics, actively listen to the team's concerns, and demonstrate value through concrete facilitation actions before introducing changes
options.B: Complain to leadership about the team's lack of cooperation in the first week
options.C: Ignore the distrust and continue as planned
options.D: Immediately impose strict new rules to establish authority

justification: Correct: observing, listening, and progressively demonstrating value is the most effective approach to building trust with a distrustful team facing a new consultant.

text: A project manager must regularly verify that executed work complies with defined technical specifications. Which quality control technique uses statistical sampling to verify a production batch's conformance?

options.A: Brainstorming
options.B: Statistical Sampling
options.C: The affinity diagram
options.D: SWOT analysis

justification: Correct: statistical sampling verifies the conformance of a production batch by inspecting a representative subset rather than 100% of units.

text: A company must decide whether to continue a project whose macroeconomic context (inflation, interest rates) has significantly deteriorated since launch. Which governance process is concerned?

options.A: Automatically adding more features
options.B: Charter review only, with no other analysis
options.C: No action is necessary as long as the project is ongoing
options.D: A business case reassessment and a portfolio review to decide on continuation, adjustment, or termination

justification: Correct: a significant macroeconomic deterioration must trigger a business case reassessment and a portfolio governance review.

text: An agile team distributed across several countries has seen a decline in social cohesion since moving to 100% remote work. Which action best rebuilds team connection?

options.A: Increase only the frequency of formal work meetings
options.B: Organize dedicated informal moments (virtual coffees, icebreakers) alongside formal ceremonies to reinforce human connection
options.C: Ignore the decline in social cohesion since it doesn't affect performance
options.D: Ban all informal communication to focus on productivity

justification: Correct: dedicated informal moments recreate the social bond lost from physical proximity, fostering cohesion and team psychological safety.

text: A project manager must determine the optimal number of suppliers to consult for a critical component. Which document formalizes the request for information or proposals from potential suppliers?

options.A: The quality management plan
options.B: The Request for Proposal (RFP) or Request for Quote (RFQ)
options.C: The Gantt chart
options.D: The risk register

justification: Correct: the RFP (or RFQ/RFI depending on the level of detail required) formalizes the solicitation of bids or information from potential suppliers in the procurement process.

text: An organization wants to align its agile teams with overall company strategy without imposing excessive control. Which scaling framework allows this balance by combining top-down vision and bottom-up execution?

options.A: Detailed daily reporting from every team to senior leadership
options.B: Scaling frameworks like SAFe or LeSS, combining a communicated strategic vision (PI Planning) with team execution autonomy
options.C: Strict hierarchical control over every team decision
options.D: Complete absence of coordination between teams and leadership

justification: Correct: frameworks like SAFe or LeSS explicitly structure the balance between communicated strategic alignment and team execution autonomy.

text: A project manager must recognize an exceptional team contribution with no budget available for a financial bonus. Which non-financial recognition is most effective?

options.A: Promise a future bonus with no certainty of delivering it
options.B: Ignore the contribution to avoid creating expectations for others
options.C: Do nothing due to lack of budget
options.D: Public recognition of the contribution, professional development opportunities (training, an exciting new project), and expanded responsibilities

justification: Correct: public recognition and development opportunities are powerful non-financial motivators aligned with esteem and achievement needs.

text: A project manager must choose the best estimation method when very little detailed information is available at startup. Which method is most appropriate?

options.A: High-level parametric or analogous estimating (order of magnitude)
options.B: Detailed bottom-up estimating
options.C: Provide no estimate until the end of the project
options.D: A hyper-detailed three-point estimate per activity

justification: Correct: at project start with little information, a high-level parametric or analogous estimate (order of magnitude, -25%/+75%) is the appropriate method.

text: The project manager must ensure a construction project complies with workplace safety standards required by local law. What is the project manager's primary responsibility on this topic?

options.A: Fully delegate with no personal follow-up
options.B: Ignore minor safety incidents
options.C: Consider safety solely the supplier's responsibility
options.D: Ensure safety standards are integrated into the project management plan, actively monitored, and respected by all parties, including subcontractors

justification: Correct: the PM must integrate and actively monitor compliance with safety standards, including at subcontractors, per their legal and ethical obligations.

text: A Scrum Master must handle a situation where the Product Owner and an external stakeholder publicly contradict each other about a feature's priority during a sprint review. Which action is appropriate in the moment?

options.A: Let the debate escalate in front of the team
options.B: Politely refocus the discussion by proposing to address the prioritization question outside the review, with the PO as final decision-maker for the backlog
options.C: Immediately cancel the sprint review
options.D: Decide the priority themselves in place of the PO

justification: Correct: the Scrum Master facilitates by refocusing the discussion and reaffirming that final prioritization authority belongs to the PO, outside the review setting.

text: A project manager must choose a contract for a research and development project with very uncertain and evolving scope. Which contract type is most appropriate?

options.A: Fixed Price with Economic Price Adjustment (FP-EPA) only
options.B: No formal contract is necessary
options.C: Cost-Reimbursable, such as Cost Plus Fixed Fee (CPFF)
options.D: Firm Fixed Price (FFP)

justification: Correct: cost-reimbursable contracts like CPFF are suited for R&D projects with uncertain scope, allowing scope flexibility with reimbursement of actual costs incurred.

text: A project manager must evaluate the impact of a tax regulation change on the budget of an international project. Which type of analysis is most appropriate?

options.A: Arbitrarily increase the budget by 5% with no analysis
options.B: Ignore the tax change until the end of the project
options.C: A budget impact analysis incorporating the new tax factor, in consultation with financial/tax experts
options.D: Fully transfer the tax risk to the client with no negotiation

justification: Correct: a rigorous impact analysis with tax experts precisely quantifies the effect of the regulatory change on the budget and allows the plan to be adjusted accordingly.

text: A multicultural Scrum team has different interpretations of what 'being open and honest' means in retrospectives, with some avoiding direct criticism out of cultural respect. Which adaptation facilitates an effective retrospective?

options.A: Use retrospective formats that allow indirect or written expression (e.g., anonymous cards) and explicitly value any constructive form of feedback
options.B: Require the same direct frankness from everyone regardless of cultural context
options.C: Hold retrospectives only with the culturally more direct members
options.D: Remove retrospectives for this multicultural team

justification: Correct: formats allowing indirect or written expression respect cultural diversity while preserving the retrospective's continuous improvement goal.

text: A project manager must identify the activities that have no float and determine the project's minimum duration. What are these activities collectively called?

options.A: Intermediate deliverables
options.B: The critical path
options.C: Project milestones
options.D: The near-critical path

justification: Correct: the critical path groups activities with zero (or minimal) total float that determine the project's minimum duration.

text: An organization notices its product's business value has stagnated despite stable agile team velocity. Which business hypothesis should be tested first?

options.A: The hypothesis that the product truly meets a valid market need (product-market fit), via experiments and user feedback
options.B: The hypothesis that velocity must still increase
options.C: The hypothesis that the number of user stories must increase
options.D: The hypothesis that the team must work more hours

justification: Correct: value stagnation despite stable production signals the need to validate the fundamental product-market fit hypothesis through concrete experiments.

text: A project manager must manage a team where a personality conflict persists despite several mediation attempts. What is the appropriate last-resort option?

options.A: Ignore the conflict indefinitely
options.B: Consider reorganizing roles or separating tasks between the two individuals as a last resort after mediation has failed
options.C: Force the two individuals to work even more closely together
options.D: Immediately fire both individuals without an HR process

justification: Correct: after mediation fails, reorganizing roles or separating tasks is a pragmatic last resort to preserve collective performance.

text: A project manager must verify whether planned quality control activities are sufficient for the project's risk level. Which quality principle states it is less costly to prevent defects than to correct them?

options.A: Little's Law
options.B: Parkinson's Law
options.C: Cost of Quality, notably the prevention versus inspection principle
options.D: The Pareto principle only

justification: Correct: the Cost of Quality concept establishes that prevention and appraisal costs are generally lower than costs of non-conformance (rework, corrections, warranties).

text: A project manager is informed that their organization is planning a merger with another company during project execution. What is the priority action?

options.A: Continue with no adjustment
options.B: Keep the information confidential from the team indefinitely
options.C: Immediately stop the project with no governance validation
options.D: Assess potential impacts on governance, funding, and project priorities, and proactively communicate with the sponsor

justification: Correct: a major organizational merger requires a proactive impact assessment and communication with the sponsor to anticipate possible priority changes.

text: A Scrum Master notices a 'name and shame' practice (pointing out the slowest developers) has taken hold in the daily scrums. What corrective action is a priority?

options.A: Let it be; it pushes the team to perform better
options.B: Further encourage the practice to maintain performance pressure
options.C: Remove the daily scrums
options.D: Intervene immediately to refocus the daily on its purpose (synchronization, obstacles) and remind the team of mutual respect norms

justification: Correct: the Scrum Master must intervene quickly to refocus the daily on its true purpose and restore mutual respect norms essential to collaboration.

text: A project manager must finalize all administrative documents and obtain the client's final sign-off at the end of the project. Which process formalizes this step?

options.A: Develop Project Team
options.B: Close Project or Phase
options.C: Direct and Manage Project Work
options.D: Plan Scope Management

justification: Correct: the 'Close Project or Phase' process finalizes all administrative activities, obtains final acceptance, and archives project documents.

text: An organization notices its agile teams regularly ignore portfolio budget constraints when prioritizing their backlog. Which governance mechanism best corrects this problem without breaking agility?

options.A: Impose line-by-line budget control at every sprint
options.B: Remove all budget constraints for agile teams
options.C: Return to project-based funding with a complete fixed upfront quote
options.D: Integrate budget envelopes (budget-based funding by increment/quarter) with regular value checkpoints rather than continuous detailed control

justification: Correct: budget envelope funding with regular value checkpoints (lean budgeting) reconciles financial discipline with execution agility.

text: A project manager notices a team member excels technically but lacks communication skills, causing friction with others. What development action is most appropriate?

options.A: Ignore the problem since technical skills compensate
options.B: Offer coaching or training in communication skills to complement their recognized technical expertise
options.C: Sanction them for their lack of relational skills
options.D: Remove them from all interactions with other members

justification: Correct: targeted communication skills development complements their technical expertise and reduces observed friction.

text: A team working in Scrumban wants to combine sprint predictability with continuous flow flexibility. Which hybrid practice characterizes this approach?

options.A: Fully abandon fixed iterations while retaining WIP limits and key Scrum ceremonies adapted to flow
options.B: Remove all flow or velocity measurements
options.C: Use no visual board at all
options.D: Use exclusively the classic waterfall cycle

justification: Correct: Scrumban typically combines removing strict fixed iterations (Kanban-style continuous flow) while retaining some Scrum ceremonies and WIP limits to manage flow.

text: A project manager must evaluate whether their organization has the internal technological capabilities to support a project requiring advanced cloud infrastructure. Which analysis is appropriate?

options.A: A customer satisfaction survey
options.B: No analysis; the organization always has the necessary capabilities
options.C: A SWOT analysis of the main competitor only
options.D: A gap analysis between current capabilities and project needs

justification: Correct: a gap analysis between current organizational capabilities and specific project needs identifies necessary investments or training.

text: A Scrum Master notices the Product Owner never consults end users directly, relying solely on management requests. What risk does this create, and what action should be recommended?

options.A: Risk of building poorly aligned features with real needs; encourage the PO to establish regular direct contact with end users
options.B: No risk; management always represents user needs well
options.C: The Scrum Master should consult users in the PO's place
options.D: Ignore the situation; it's not the Scrum Master's role

justification: Correct: without direct contact with end users, the risk of product misalignment is real; the Scrum Master can coach the PO on the importance of direct user discovery.

text: A project manager must ensure all technical deliverable configuration changes are properly tracked. Which process/tool manages this?

options.A: The RACI matrix
options.B: Configuration Management
options.C: The Ishikawa diagram
options.D: The Kanban board

justification: Correct: configuration management ensures systematic tracking of versions and modifications to technical deliverables and their characteristics.

text: An organization evaluates the environmental impact (carbon footprint) of the cloud infrastructure used by its continuous development teams. Which action illustrates coherent integration of sustainability criteria in an agile context?

options.A: Completely ignore the carbon footprint since it's not a product priority
options.B: Wait for strict regulation before acting
options.C: Address sustainability only in a separate annual report unrelated to the backlog
options.D: Integrate sustainability criteria (infrastructure choice, cloud resource optimization) as acceptance criteria in certain technical user stories

justification: Correct: integrating sustainability criteria directly into acceptance criteria of technical user stories allows concrete, incremental action consistent with agility.

text: A project manager must ensure team members clearly understand role expectations from the start of the project. Which document best formalizes this in a predictive context?

options.A: The closure report
options.B: The risk register
options.C: The role and responsibility descriptions in the resource management plan
options.D: The supplier contract

justification: Correct: the resource management plan includes clear descriptions of roles, responsibilities, and authority levels, essential for clarifying expectations from the start.

text: A project manager must anticipate the impacts of a risk on several project objectives simultaneously (cost, schedule, quality). Which qualitative analysis tool helps visualize this relationship?

options.A: The Kanban board
options.B: Team members' resumes
options.C: The multi-criteria probability and impact matrix
options.D: A simple Gantt chart

justification: Correct: a multi-criteria probability/impact matrix allows simultaneous evaluation of a risk's effect on multiple objectives (cost, schedule, quality, scope).

text: The project manager must ensure their project respects personal data governance principles (e.g., GDPR) when collecting customer data. What action is essential from the design phase?

options.A: Integrate the 'privacy by design' principle from the outset and document data protection measures
options.B: Handle GDPR compliance only after deployment to production
options.C: Ignore GDPR if the project is for internal use only
options.D: Fully delegate the matter to the legal department with no project involvement

justification: Correct: the 'privacy by design' principle requires integrating data protection from the design stage, a fundamental GDPR requirement and good compliance practice.

text: An Agile Coach observes a high-performing team showing signs of burnout (rising absenteeism, irritability). What is the priority action to preserve sustainable performance?

options.A: Praise the team and give them even more work to capitalize on their performance
options.B: Maintain the same pace since results are excellent
options.C: Investigate the signs of burnout, adjust workload, and reinforce the agile principle of sustainable pace
options.D: Ignore the signs as long as velocity remains stable

justification: Correct: investigating and adjusting workload per the sustainable pace principle prevents burnout and preserves long-term performance.

text: A project manager must decide how to manage an activity whose duration strongly depends on an uncertain external factor (e.g., customs clearance time). Which estimation technique best reflects this uncertainty?

options.A: A single point estimate with no margin
options.B: Don't estimate this activity at all
options.C: Ignore the uncertainty and use the most optimistic duration
options.D: Three-point estimating (optimistic, most likely, pessimistic) with the PERT formula

justification: Correct: three-point estimating (PERT) explicitly captures uncertainty via optimistic, pessimistic, and most likely scenarios, suited to uncertain external factors.

text: A project manager must manage the expectations of an investor demanding a faster return on investment than is realistic. Which communication approach is appropriate?

options.A: Present a factual, transparent analysis of realistic timelines backed by performance and risk data
options.B: Agree to reduce quality to meet the investor's desired deadline without informing other stakeholders
options.C: Promise an unrealistic deadline to satisfy the investor
options.D: Avoid all direct communication with the investor

justification: Correct: factual, transparent communication backed by concrete data is essential for honestly managing an investor's expectations.

text: An agile team occasionally practices mob programming, but some developers find it slows their perceived individual productivity. What is the best way to objectively evaluate the practice?

options.A: Continue indefinitely without ever evaluating impact
options.B: Abandon it immediately based on individual impressions
options.C: Impose mob programming 100% of the time without discussion
options.D: Objectively measure the impact on shared metrics (code quality, defect resolution time, knowledge sharing) rather than perceived individual productivity

justification: Correct: evaluating objective shared metrics allows a data-driven decision rather than one based on subjective perceived individual productivity.

text: A project manager must determine the free float of a non-critical activity. What does this measure represent precisely?

options.A: The number of resources available for the activity
options.B: The remaining budget allocated to the activity
options.C: The total time available before the end of the project
options.D: The amount of time an activity can be delayed without delaying the early start date of the following activity

justification: Correct: free float is the delay possible for an activity without impacting the early start date of the immediately following activity.

text: A donor funding an agile project to develop a social application requires detailed quarterly impact reports. How can this requirement be reconciled with the agile rhythm of continuous delivery?

options.A: Refuse to provide the reports requested by the donor
options.B: Create a reporting process entirely disconnected from the team's actual work
options.C: Build quarterly impact reports from value metrics already tracked continuously (OKRs, adoption, feedback), without a heavy parallel reporting process
options.D: Abandon the agile approach for simpler reporting

justification: Correct: reusing already continuously tracked value metrics to feed quarterly reports avoids duplicate reporting work while meeting donor requirements.

text: A project manager must decide how to distribute tasks among team members based on their individual strengths. Which human resources management approach is most effective?

options.A: Distribute tasks randomly for fairness
options.B: Align task assignments with each member's strengths, expertise, and development interests, while balancing overall workload
options.C: Let each member choose freely with no coordination
options.D: Always give the hardest tasks only to the most experienced members

justification: Correct: aligning tasks with individual strengths while balancing overall workload optimizes both performance and team engagement.

text: A project manager must anticipate activities that must mandatorily precede others due to the physical nature of the work (e.g., foundations before walls). What dependency type does this illustrate?

options.A: No dependency is necessary
options.B: External dependency
options.C: Mandatory dependency (Hard Logic)
options.D: Discretionary dependency (Soft Logic)

justification: Correct: a mandatory dependency (hard logic) results from the intrinsic physical nature of the work, such as needing foundations before walls.

text: A project manager must ensure their organization respects intellectual property requirements when developing a product that uses open source components. What action is essential?

options.A: Ignore intellectual property concerns to speed up development
options.B: Use components without checking their license, since they are free
options.C: Verify the license of each open source component and ensure their compatibility with the intended commercial use
options.D: Consider that open source has no legal implications

justification: Correct: open source licenses vary considerably (permissive, copyleft) and must be checked to ensure compatibility with the product's intended commercial use.

text: A Scrum Master notices a very cohesive team unconsciously excludes ideas from a new member with a different background (groupthink). What action fosters better diversity of thought?

options.A: Ignore the groupthink phenomenon
options.B: Let the group continue, cohesion takes priority over diversity of opinion
options.C: Remove the new member from the team to avoid tension
options.D: Deliberately introduce techniques favoring divergent perspectives (devil's advocate, systematic round-robin) and explicitly value the new member's contributions

justification: Correct: structured techniques like devil's advocate or systematic round-robin actively counter groupthink and value diverse perspectives.

text: A project manager must choose the simplest progress measurement method for very short-duration activities (less than a week). Which EVM formula is generally used?

options.A: Detailed daily subjective estimation
options.B: Monte Carlo analysis
options.C: The 0/100 formula (0% until complete, 100% once complete)
options.D: The Pareto diagram

justification: Correct: for very short-duration activities, the 0/100 formula is simple and avoids the bias of a hard-to-justify intermediate estimate.

text: A project manager notices a team member is slightly falsifying progress reports to avoid difficult questions from the sponsor. What is the appropriate action per the PMI Code of Ethics?

options.A: Cover up the falsification to protect the team member
options.B: Immediately correct the information, restore transparency with the sponsor, and remind the team of the importance of honesty in reporting
options.C: Also falsify other reports to maintain consistency
options.D: Ignore it if the discrepancy is minor and seemingly without consequence

justification: Correct: the Code of Ethics requires immediate corrective action to restore transparency and reaffirm reporting integrity standards with the team.

text: A Scrum Master notices the team never questions the estimates of the most senior member, even when they seem unrealistic. What bias does this illustrate and what should be done?

options.A: No bias, it's normal to trust experience
options.B: An authority bias; introduce anonymous voting (Planning Poker) so everyone estimates independently before discussion
options.C: Remove team estimation entirely
options.D: Ask the senior member to estimate everything alone from now on

justification: Correct: Planning Poker with simultaneous, anonymous voting reduces authority influence and encourages fairer collective estimation.

text: A project manager must verify that the risk management plan includes a strategy for positive risks (opportunities). Which strategy is appropriate to fully exploit an opportunity?

options.A: Exploit
options.B: Avoid
options.C: Mitigate
options.D: Transfer

justification: Correct: the 'Exploit' strategy aims to guarantee full materialization of an opportunity, unlike negative risk strategies.

text: A project manager must evaluate whether a project remains aligned with the social mission of an NGO funded by several international donors. Which reference document guides this evaluation?

options.A: The project's logical framework (logframe) and development objectives defined with donors
options.B: The team's Kanban board
options.C: The project manager's resume
options.D: The detailed daily task schedule

justification: Correct: the logframe formalizes development objectives and impact indicators agreed with donors, an essential reference for verifying strategic alignment.

text: An agile team finds that high member turnover is hurting its velocity and cohesion. What structural action should leadership prioritize?

options.A: Ignore the turnover; it's not manageable
options.B: Reduce team size to compensate
options.C: Investigate root causes of turnover (workload, recognition, career prospects) through exit interviews and adjust managerial practices
options.D: Recruit urgently with no structured onboarding process

justification: Correct: understanding root causes through exit interviews and adjusting managerial practices is the proactive approach to durably reduce turnover.

text: A project manager must determine how much float exists on the critical path before it affects the project end date. What is the total float on the critical path by definition?

options.A: Zero (or the network's minimum value)
options.B: Always equal to the total project duration
options.C: Always equal to the total budget
options.D: Undetermined without additional data

justification: Correct: by definition, critical path activities have zero (or minimal network value) total float, meaning no delay is possible without affecting the end date.

text: A startup developing an agile product must decide whether to invest more in acquiring new customers or retaining existing ones with a limited budget. What data should guide this decision?

options.A: The founder's personal preference only
options.B: The number of features already developed
options.C: The size of the development team
options.D: A comparative analysis of customer acquisition cost (CAC) and lifetime value (LTV), as well as current retention rates

justification: Correct: comparing CAC, LTV, and retention rates provides a factual basis for arbitrating between acquisition and retention investment.

text: A project manager must manage a stakeholder who frequently changes their mind about requirements, creating confusion in the team. Which stakeholder management skill is most useful here?

options.A: Ignore their requests systematically
options.B: Exclude them from future meetings
options.C: Clarify the formal change management process with them and document each request for traceability and consistency
options.D: Accept all changes immediately with no documentation

justification: Correct: clarifying and enforcing the formal change management process channels requests while ensuring traceability and consistency for the team.

text: An agile team must decide how to manage defects discovered in production during an ongoing sprint. What is the recommended practice?

options.A: Stop all new feature development until the end of the project
options.B: Ignore all production defects
options.C: Always wait until the next sprint for any defect, without exception
options.D: Assess the defect's criticality with the PO and team, and integrate it into the current sprint if business impact justifies an interruption, otherwise prioritize it in the backlog

justification: Correct: assessing criticality with the PO allows a pragmatic decision balancing sprint stability with the necessary responsiveness for impactful defects.

text: A project manager must integrate digital accessibility requirements (e.g., WCAG) imposed by a new law into an already-ongoing web development project. What is the best approach?

options.A: Stop the project completely
options.B: Ignore the law since the project is already underway
options.C: Indefinitely postpone compliance without a plan
options.D: Assess the current compliance gap, update requirements and the project management plan accordingly, prioritizing critical fixes

justification: Correct: assessing the compliance gap and integrating necessary corrections into the project management plan is the proactive compliance approach, even mid-execution.

text: A Scrum Master must accompany a team that just underwent a complete change in composition (50% new members). According to Tuckman's model, which stage should the team likely revisit?

options.A: Forming, since a major composition change calls established norms and relationships into question
options.B: No stage, the model doesn't apply to team composition changes
options.C: Adjourning, since the previous team is dissolved
options.D: Performing directly, since the team already existed

justification: Correct: a significant change in composition (50%) generally returns the team to a Forming stage, requiring rebuilding of trust and norms.

text: A project manager must ensure the project budget covers identified risks with an appropriate margin. What does the contingency reserve represent within the total project budget?

options.A: The project manager's salary
options.B: An additional amount for identified known risks (known-unknowns), typically calculated via EMV
options.C: Raw material costs only
options.D: A fixed amount independent of any risk analysis

justification: Correct: the contingency reserve covers known and identified risks (known-unknowns), generally calculated through expected monetary value (EMV) analysis.

text: An organization evaluates whether to continue funding a digital product after 18 months without meeting adoption targets. Which Lean Startup principle guides this decision?

options.A: Continue indefinitely as a matter of persistence
options.B: Automatically double the budget without analysis
options.C: The 'pivot or persevere' principle based on hypothesis validation data (build-measure-learn)
options.D: Stop immediately without analyzing the causes of underperformance

justification: Correct: the build-measure-learn cycle guides the 'pivot or persevere' decision based on actual adoption and hypothesis validation data.

text: A project manager must manage a disagreement between the sponsor and a key stakeholder over the definition of project success. What facilitation action is appropriate?

options.A: Arbitrarily choose one viewpoint without discussion
options.B: Ignore the disagreement and hope it resolves itself
options.C: Organize a joint clarification session to align success criteria and formally document them in the charter or project management plan
options.D: Let the team decide the success criteria without involving the sponsor

justification: Correct: a formal clarification session with documented, aligned success criteria prevents future misunderstandings about the definition of project success.

text: A project manager must select a statistical control tool to verify whether a production process stays within acceptable limits over time. Which tool is most appropriate?

options.A: The RACI matrix
options.B: The control chart with upper and lower control limits
options.C: The affinity diagram
options.D: The Ishikawa diagram

justification: Correct: the control chart monitors process stability over time, identifying variations outside acceptable control limits.

text: An international project manager must ensure the project simultaneously complies with anti-corruption laws in both the home country and the country of execution. What practice is essential?

options.A: Fully delegate to a local third party with no oversight
options.B: Apply only the less restrictive law of the two countries
options.C: Apply the stricter standard between the two jurisdictions and document compliance for both legal frameworks
options.D: Ignore anti-corruption laws if local practices differ

justification: Correct: applying the stricter standard between jurisdictions is the prudent compliance practice for extraterritorial laws like anti-corruption legislation (e.g., FCPA).

text: An agile team must integrate an external consultant for a one-off expertise on a complex technical component. Which action best facilitates their integration without disrupting team dynamics?

options.A: Give them final decision authority over the entire architecture
options.B: Exclude them from all ceremonies so as not to slow the team down
options.C: Never document their work to stay flexible
options.D: Include them in relevant ceremonies, clarify the scope and duration of their engagement, and facilitate knowledge transfer to the permanent team

justification: Correct: targeted inclusion, clear scope, and planned knowledge transfer maximize the value of external expertise while preserving the permanent team's autonomy.

text: A project manager must ensure stakeholder requirements are properly gathered before detailed planning. Which requirements gathering technique is most suited for a small group of experts with potentially divergent views?

options.A: A mass anonymous survey of all employees
options.B: The Delphi technique (iterative anonymous consultation of experts)
options.C: A single unstructured meeting
options.D: No consultation; the project manager decides alone

justification: Correct: the Delphi technique allows iterative, anonymous consultation of experts to converge toward consensus while reducing group influence bias.

text: An organization wants to evaluate if its target market is evolving faster than its ability to deliver via its current agile model. Which external strategic indicator should be monitored as a priority?

options.A: The number of planning meetings held
options.B: The number of sprints completed
options.C: The evolution of customer needs and competing offerings (market intelligence) compared to the organization's value delivery pace
options.D: The number of user stories in the backlog

justification: Correct: comparing market and competitive evolution to value delivery pace assesses whether the organization risks losing strategic relevance.

text: A project manager must manage a team where two sub-groups have formed informally, creating unhealthy competition. What leadership action is most appropriate?

options.A: Encourage the competition between sub-groups to stimulate performance
options.B: Ignore the fragmentation as long as the work progresses
options.C: Disband the entire team and start over
options.D: Foster shared cross-functional goals and activities to rebuild a unified team identity and reduce fragmentation

justification: Correct: shared cross-functional goals and activities rebuild a unified team identity and reduce competing sub-group dynamics.

text: A team using Scrum wants to improve the quality of its user stories before they enter the sprint. Which standard criterion is most useful for evaluating user story quality?

options.A: The number of technical keywords used
options.B: The INVEST criterion (Independent, Negotiable, Valuable, Estimable, Small, Testable)
options.C: The alphabetical order of the title
options.D: The length of the user story text only

justification: Correct: the INVEST criterion is the recognized standard for evaluating whether a user story is well-formed before entering the sprint.

text: A project manager must verify that costs incurred to date correspond to work actually performed. Which EVM indicator represents the actual cost spent?

options.A: Planned Value (PV)
options.B: Actual Cost (AC)
options.C: Cost Performance Index (CPI)
options.D: Earned Value (EV)

justification: Correct: Actual Cost (AC) represents the amount actually spent on the work performed at a given date.

text: A team working on a complex product uses Story Mapping to organize its backlog. What main benefit does this technique bring compared to a simple prioritized list?

options.A: It visualizes the overall user journey and helps identify functionally coherent minimum viable releases (MVP)
options.B: It completely replaces individual user stories
options.C: It eliminates the need to prioritize
options.D: It eliminates the need to collaborate with users

justification: Correct: Story Mapping visualizes the end-to-end user journey, helping identify coherent value slices for functional MVP releases.

text: A project manager must decide how to manage a temporary team formed only for the project's duration, with a risk of demotivation from lacking a long-term prospect. Which motivational action is appropriate?

options.A: Systematically promise a permanent position with no certainty
options.B: Ignore the topic; the team is temporary anyway
options.C: Lower performance expectations to compensate for the lack of prospects
options.D: Clarify project objectives and offer learning and skill development opportunities valuable for members' future careers

justification: Correct: offering valuable learning and career development opportunities is durable intrinsic motivation, even for a temporary team.

text: A project manager must justify to leadership why a higher initial investment in quality will reduce total costs over the product lifecycle. Which economic concept supports this argument?

options.A: Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), including non-conformance costs avoided long-term
options.B: The number of employees involved in the project
options.C: The initial purchase price only
options.D: The project duration only

justification: Correct: TCO demonstrates that an initial investment in quality often reduces non-conformance costs (rework, warranties, dissatisfaction) over the entire lifecycle.

text: A Product Owner and the development team have divergent views on the definition of 'value' for a feature (one favors revenue, the other user experience). Which approach best resolves this disagreement?

options.A: Impose the PO's view without discussion, since they have backlog authority
options.B: Let the development team alone decide the definition of value
options.C: Ignore the disagreement and move forward without alignment
options.D: Facilitate an explicit discussion on the product's value criteria (business, user, technical) to build a shared, balanced definition

justification: Correct: building a shared, multidimensional definition of value (business, user, technical) aligns team and PO on common priorities.

text: A project manager must choose the best method to validate that a complex deliverable meets all functional requirements before going to production. Which activity is appropriate?

options.A: User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
options.B: The affinity diagram
options.C: SWOT analysis
options.D: Team brainstorming

justification: Correct: User Acceptance Testing (UAT) formally validates that the deliverable meets functional requirements from the end user's perspective before production.

text: A nonprofit organization using agile methods must report on the social impact of its projects to donors, beyond velocity metrics. Which measurement approach is most appropriate?

options.A: Develop specific social impact indicators (e.g., beneficiaries reached, measured behavior change) aligned with the organization's theory of change
options.B: Ignore any impact measurement since agile methods don't lend themselves to it
options.C: Only communicate velocity and the number of sprints completed
options.D: Limit reporting to the number of completed user stories

justification: Correct: specific social impact indicators, aligned with the organization's theory of change, meet donor accountability expectations, complementing internal agile metrics.

text: A project manager must decide how to manage a highly skilled team member who consistently refuses to document their work, creating a bus factor risk. What action is appropriate?

options.A: Document their work for them indefinitely
options.B: Replace them immediately without discussion
options.C: Explain the organizational risk of lacking documentation and make documentation an explicit performance expectation
options.D: Accept the situation because their technical skills are indispensable

justification: Correct: explaining the organizational risk and making documentation an explicit performance expectation holds the person accountable while reducing dependency risk.

text: An agile team wants to improve visibility into technical dependencies with other teams. Which coordination tool is most appropriate at multi-team scale?

options.A: Share nothing between teams
options.B: A cross-team dependency board updated during the Scrum of Scrums
options.C: A single meeting at project start with no follow-up
options.D: An annual summary email

justification: Correct: a cross-team dependency board regularly updated during the Scrum of Scrums offers continuous, actionable visibility on technical dependencies.

text: A project manager must evaluate the impact of a newly imposed trade embargo on the supply of critical components for an industrial project. What is the first appropriate action?

options.A: Illegally circumvent the embargo through undeclared intermediaries
options.B: Stop the project without consulting governance
options.C: Assess the impact on the supply chain, identify compliant alternative suppliers, and update the risk register
options.D: Continue without adjustment, hoping the embargo is lifted quickly

justification: Correct: assessing the real impact, identifying compliant alternatives, and documenting the risk is the proactive, legal approach appropriate for an embargo.

text: A Scrum Master notices a team member consistently criticizes group decisions after the fact, without ever speaking up during meetings. What phenomenon does this illustrate, and what action should be taken?

options.A: Systematically ignore their after-the-fact criticism
options.B: Exclude this member from future decisions
options.C: This is normal and has no consequences for the team
options.D: This illustrates a lack of psychological safety in meetings; create alternative expression spaces and explicitly encourage speaking up during decisions, not after

justification: Correct: systematic after-the-fact criticism without in-meeting expression often signals a lack of psychological safety; alternative spaces and explicit encouragement foster more constructive real-time expression.

text: A project manager must establish a formal system for managing change requests throughout the project. Which body is generally responsible for approving or rejecting these requests?
