options.C: Assume all monetary values will always be displayed and calculated in a single currency regardless of user location
options.D: Incorporate currency formatting and conversion accuracy testing as an explicit consideration in the Definition of Done for features involving monetary values across a global user base

justification: Correct. Explicitly incorporating currency formatting and conversion accuracy testing into the Definition of Done ensures this important consideration is consistently addressed for relevant global commerce features.

text: A team has completed 8 Sprints of a planned 12-Sprint release. Their velocity has been trending downward over the last 3 Sprints (45, 38, 32 points respectively), while the remaining Product Backlog for the release totals 280 points. The Product Owner is concerned about meeting the fixed release date and asks the Scrum Master for guidance. What is the BEST way for the Scrum Master to respond?

options.A: Facilitate a Retrospective-style investigation into the reasons behind the declining velocity trend, and use the actual current trend (not historical peak) to realistically forecast remaining capacity, informing a data-driven conversation about scope or timeline adjustments
options.B: Reassure the Product Owner that velocity will naturally recover to its earlier higher levels without further investigation
options.C: Ignore the declining trend and continue planning based on the original, now outdated velocity assumptions from early Sprints
options.D: Immediately conclude the team is underperforming and recommend replacing several team members

justification: Correct. Investigating the root cause of the decline while using the actual current trend for realistic forecasting provides the Product Owner with genuinely evidence-based information to make an informed scope or timeline decision, reflecting proper empirical, inspect-and-adapt practice.

text: A project manager wants to determine the appropriate way to handle a situation where a team member has expressed feeling that their work-from-home setup is significantly less comfortable than the office environment other colleagues enjoy. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Dismiss the concern since home office setup is entirely the individual's own responsibility
options.B: Ignore the concern since remote work inherently involves some degree of environmental disparity
options.C: Require them to work from the office exclusively to eliminate the disparity
options.D: Explore what support the organization might reasonably provide (e.g., equipment stipend, ergonomic guidance) and connect them with relevant organizational resources if available

justification: Correct. Exploring reasonable organizational support and connecting them with relevant resources reflects genuine care for their wellbeing and equitable working conditions within the organization's actual capacity.

text: A team wants to reduce the risk of a Sprint's Increment lacking adequate consideration of proper input validation for a feature accepting user-generated content. What is the BEST proactive practice?

options.A: Incorporate input validation and sanitization testing as an explicit part of the Definition of Done for features accepting user-generated content, considering both malicious and accidental malformed input
options.B: Skip input validation entirely to speed up feature delivery
options.C: Address input validation issues only after a security incident or data corruption problem actually occurs
options.D: Assume all user input will always be well-formed and benign without any specific validation

justification: Correct. Explicitly incorporating input validation and sanitization testing into the Definition of Done ensures this critical security and data integrity consideration is consistently addressed for user-generated content features.

text: An agile team's organization is exploring a shift toward supporting a subscription pause feature (allowing customers to temporarily pause rather than cancel their subscription) to reduce churn. What should the product leader do FIRST?

options.A: Immediately build the pause feature without any analysis of its potential impact on revenue or actual customer demand
options.B: Model the potential impact on revenue and retention, and validate genuine customer demand for a pause option before committing significant backlog investment
options.C: Ignore the idea since it might reduce immediate cancellation-driven revenue recognition
options.D: Assume all customers who would otherwise cancel would instead choose to pause, without any actual data

justification: Correct. Modeling potential impact and validating genuine demand before major investment reflects responsible, evidence-based evaluation of a feature with real revenue and retention implications.

text: A project manager needs to determine the appropriate way to handle a situation where a project's actual meeting attendance rate has been declining despite no change in meeting frequency or format. What is the BEST way to investigate this?

options.A: Ignore the declining attendance since meeting participation is not a critical project success factor
options.B: Investigate potential underlying causes such as meeting relevance, scheduling conflicts, or meeting fatigue, gathering direct feedback from team members
options.C: Assume team members are simply becoming less committed to the project
options.D: Immediately mandate attendance with strict enforcement measures without understanding the actual cause

justification: Correct. Investigating potential causes like relevance, scheduling conflicts, or fatigue, combined with direct feedback, reflects proper root cause analysis for a genuine declining engagement pattern.

text: A team member consistently expresses that they feel their contributions are undervalued because they primarily work on internal tooling that improves the team's own productivity, rather than customer-facing features. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Dismiss their concern since internal tooling work is inherently less valuable than customer-facing feature development
options.B: Ignore the concern since internal tooling work is a necessary role regardless of how it's perceived
options.C: Reassign them exclusively to customer-facing work regardless of their actual skills or the team's tooling needs
options.D: Make the value of their internal tooling work explicitly visible by connecting it to concrete outcomes like team velocity improvements or reduced defect rates that ultimately benefit customers

justification: Correct. Making the tooling work's value explicitly visible by connecting it to concrete downstream outcomes directly addresses the recognition gap while preserving the value of this important productivity-enabling work.

text: Which of the following are valid components of a comprehensive project status report? (Select TWO)

options.A: Current schedule and cost performance against baseline
options.B: Key risks and issues requiring stakeholder attention
options.C: The complete personal contact information of every team member's family members
options.D: Unrelated details about a different, unrelated project in the organization

justification: Correct. Current schedule and cost performance against baseline is a fundamental, standard component of an effective project status report. / Correct. Key risks and issues requiring stakeholder attention are essential components of a comprehensive status report, supporting informed decision-making.

text: A project manager's organization is subject to a new mandatory algorithmic transparency requirement affecting how the project's automated decision-making system must explain its outputs to affected individuals. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Review the specific transparency requirements, assess gaps in the current system's explainability, and incorporate necessary enhancements into the project plan
options.B: Provide generic, non-specific explanations to technically satisfy the requirement without genuine improvement to system transparency
options.C: Ignore the requirement since algorithmic transparency is considered purely a data science/engineering matter, not a project management concern
options.D: Assume the current system already provides adequate explanation without any actual assessment against the new requirement

justification: Correct. Reviewing specific requirements, assessing gaps, and incorporating necessary enhancements reflects responsible, proactive integration of a legitimate and increasingly important algorithmic transparency requirement.

text: A team's Scrum Master notices that team members frequently express uncertainty about how conflicts between personal priorities and team commitments should be resolved. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Facilitate a discussion to establish reasonable, explicit team norms for how such conflicts should typically be navigated, balancing individual needs with team commitments
options.B: Tell the team that personal priorities should always be sacrificed for team commitments without exception
options.C: Require team members to always prioritize personal matters over any team commitment regardless of circumstances
options.D: Ignore the uncertainty since personal priority conflicts are considered entirely outside the team's scope to address

justification: Correct. Facilitating a discussion to establish reasonable, explicit norms directly addresses the uncertainty while supporting a balanced approach that respects both individual needs and team commitments.

text: A team wants to reduce the risk of a Sprint's Increment lacking adequate consideration of rate limiting to prevent abuse of a public-facing API endpoint. What is the BEST proactive practice?

options.A: Skip rate limiting consideration entirely since it is considered a low-priority concern for most APIs
options.B: Incorporate rate limiting design and testing as an explicit consideration in the Definition of Done for features involving public-facing API endpoints
options.C: Address rate limiting only after the API experiences an actual abuse incident or performance degradation
options.D: Assume all API consumers will always use the endpoint responsibly without any need for rate limiting

justification: Correct. Explicitly incorporating rate limiting design and testing into the Definition of Done ensures this important protective measure is consistently addressed for public-facing API features.

text: Match each type of strategic partnership model to its correct description.

colonne_droite.texte: Two companies technically integrating their products to offer combined functionality to shared customers
Two companies jointly promoting each other's products to their respective customer bases
One company selling another's product through their existing sales or distribution channels
Two companies forming a new, separate entity to pursue a shared business opportunity

justification: This type of partnership involves technically connecting two companies' products so they work together, providing combined value to shared customers. / Co-marketing partnerships involve two companies jointly promoting each other's offerings, leveraging combined marketing reach and credibility. / Distribution partnerships involve one company selling another's product through their own established sales or distribution channels, expanding market reach. / A joint venture involves two companies creating a new, separate legal entity specifically to pursue a shared business opportunity, sharing risk and reward.

text: A project manager wants to determine the appropriate way to handle a situation where a team member consistently expresses that they feel micromanaged by a peer (not their formal manager) who frequently checks on their progress unprompted. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Ignore the concern since peer-to-peer dynamics are entirely outside the project manager's involvement
options.B: Tell the affected team member to simply tolerate the behavior since it comes from a peer, not a manager
options.C: Require the peer to never check in on anyone's progress under any circumstances
options.D: Facilitate a conversation between the two peers to understand the checking-in peer's intent and establish mutually comfortable boundaries around progress check-ins

justification: Correct. Facilitating a conversation to understand intent and establish mutually comfortable boundaries directly addresses the concern constructively, respecting both parties' perspectives.

text: A project manager needs to determine the appropriate way to handle a situation where a project's actual document version control has led to multiple team members working from outdated versions of key project documents. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Eliminate all shared documents entirely to avoid version control issues
options.B: Implement a clear document version control system with defined naming conventions and a single source of truth location, ensuring the team understands and consistently uses it
options.C: Require every team member to independently verify document currency through informal channels each time, with no centralized system
options.D: Ignore the version control issue since documents are eventually updated regardless

justification: Correct. Implementing a clear version control system with defined conventions and a single source of truth directly addresses the root cause of the described document confusion.

text: An agile team's organization is exploring a shift toward supporting a peer-to-peer marketplace feature within the existing product, allowing users to transact directly with each other. What should the product leader do FIRST?

options.A: Immediately build the peer-to-peer marketplace without researching applicable marketplace liability regulations or payment processing requirements
options.B: Refuse to explore the idea since it represents a significant departure from the current product's core functionality
options.C: Assume peer-to-peer marketplace regulations are identical to the organization's existing direct-sale business model
options.D: Research applicable marketplace liability regulations, payment processing requirements, and dispute resolution considerations before committing significant backlog investment

justification: Correct. Researching applicable regulations and requirements before major investment reflects responsible, evidence-based evaluation of a feature involving genuinely complex legal and operational considerations distinct from the organization's current business model.

text: A project manager needs to determine the appropriate way to handle a situation where a project's actual escalation response time from senior management has been significantly slower than the target defined in the communications management plan. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Assume the escalation target was simply set unrealistically and immediately lower it without any discussion
options.B: Ignore the slow response time since senior management's schedule constraints are outside the project manager's influence
options.C: Stop escalating issues to senior management entirely due to their slow response pattern
options.D: Discuss the discrepancy directly with senior management to understand the cause and agree on a realistic, mutually workable escalation response expectation

justification: Correct. Directly discussing the discrepancy with senior management to understand the cause and agree on realistic expectations reflects proactive stakeholder communication management appropriate for addressing a significant communication plan gap.

text: A team member consistently expresses that they feel their contributions during technical design discussions are dismissed because they come from a less traditional educational background compared to colleagues with formal computer science degrees. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Agree that formal educational background should determine whose technical input is valued most
options.B: Explicitly reinforce that technical contributions should be evaluated on their actual merit, regardless of educational background, and address any specific dismissive behavior directly if identified
options.C: Exclude them from technical design discussions since their background differs from the majority
options.D: Ignore the concern since educational background differences are simply an unavoidable reality in technical fields

justification: Correct. Explicitly reinforcing merit-based evaluation regardless of background, combined with addressing specific dismissive behaviors, directly counters the harmful bias and supports a fair, inclusive technical culture.

text: Which of the following are appropriate ways to handle a situation where a team's Increment includes a feature that works correctly but has an unexpectedly high infrastructure cost per user? (Select TWO)

options.A: Transparently communicate the cost finding to the Product Owner and relevant stakeholders, discussing whether cost optimization work should be prioritized
options.B: Investigate potential cost optimization approaches (e.g., caching, more efficient algorithms) that could be added as future backlog items
options.C: Hide the cost finding from stakeholders to avoid drawing attention to the issue
options.D: Ignore the cost finding entirely since the feature is functionally working as intended

justification: Correct. Transparently communicating the cost finding and discussing prioritization reflects Scrum's transparency principle and supports informed decision-making about a genuine business cost concern. / Correct. Investigating potential cost optimization approaches for future backlog consideration reflects proactive, responsible technical stewardship in response to a discovered cost issue.

text: A project manager's organization is subject to a new mandatory disaster recovery capability requirement for critical business systems following a recent industry-wide outage event. What is the BEST way to address this for the current project?

options.A: Assume the current system already has adequate disaster recovery capability without any actual assessment
options.B: Ignore the requirement since disaster recovery is considered purely an IT infrastructure matter, not a project management concern
options.C: Implement generic disaster recovery best practices without specifically verifying against the actual mandated requirements
options.D: Conduct a disaster recovery capability assessment against the specific new requirements, and incorporate necessary enhancements into the project plan with appropriate prioritization

justification: Correct. Conducting a proper assessment and incorporating necessary enhancements with appropriate prioritization reflects responsible, evidence-based integration of a significant new business continuity requirement.

text: A team's Scrum Master notices that team members frequently express frustration about not understanding why certain historical technical decisions were made, since the original decision-makers have since left the organization. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Encourage the team to establish and maintain lightweight decision documentation practices going forward, while acknowledging that some historical context may unfortunately be permanently lost
options.B: Require the team to reverse-engineer and guess at the reasoning behind every past decision, regardless of practicality
options.C: Tell the team that understanding historical decisions is unimportant since the decisions are already made
options.D: Ignore the frustration since historical context loss is an unavoidable, unaddressable reality of team turnover

justification: Correct. Establishing lightweight documentation practices going forward, while realistically acknowledging some past context may be lost, addresses the future risk constructively without pretending the current historical gap can necessarily be fully resolved.

text: A team wants to reduce the risk of a Sprint's Increment lacking adequate consideration of graceful handling for users on outdated browser or app versions. What is the BEST proactive practice?

options.A: Assume all users will always immediately update to the latest browser or app version
options.B: Address outdated version issues only after users on old versions report broken functionality
options.C: Incorporate graceful degradation or clear upgrade prompts for outdated versions, informed by actual data on the current distribution of user browser/app versions
options.D: Skip consideration of outdated versions entirely since supporting them is considered too resource-intensive

justification: Correct. Incorporating graceful degradation or clear upgrade prompts, informed by actual version distribution data, directly addresses genuine user needs based on evidence rather than assumption.

text: An agile team's organization is exploring a shift toward supporting a referral rewards program to drive customer acquisition through word-of-mouth. What should the product leader do FIRST?

options.A: Model the potential cost and expected acquisition impact, and validate genuine customer willingness to refer others before committing significant backlog investment
options.B: Ignore the idea since it deviates from the current customer acquisition approach
options.C: Immediately build a comprehensive referral rewards system without modeling its potential cost or validating genuine customer interest in referring others
options.D: Assume referral rewards will automatically be effective regardless of the actual reward structure or customer motivation

justification: Correct. Modeling potential cost and impact, and validating genuine customer willingness to refer, before major investment reflects responsible, evidence-based evaluation of a marketing/growth feature with real financial implications.

text: A project manager wants to determine the appropriate way to handle a situation where a team member consistently expresses that they feel their bilingual skills are underutilized despite being relevant to the project's international stakeholders. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Ignore their skills entirely since their formal role doesn't explicitly include translation or interpretation duties
options.B: Assume they don't actually want their bilingual skills utilized since they haven't been asked to use them
options.C: Explore appropriate ways to leverage their bilingual skills for relevant international stakeholder interactions, respecting their formal role while valuing this additional capability
options.D: Require them to handle all international communication regardless of their actual workload capacity

justification: Correct. Exploring appropriate ways to leverage their bilingual skills, while respecting their formal role and workload, values their additional capability without disregarding their primary responsibilities.

text: A project manager notices that a team member consistently takes on extra responsibilities to help the team but rarely asks for help themselves, even when visibly struggling. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Publicly praise their self-sufficiency to encourage them to continue never asking for help
options.B: Assume they don't actually need any help since they haven't explicitly asked for it
options.C: Proactively check in privately to understand their actual workload and offer support, creating space for them to accept help without needing to explicitly request it
options.D: Ignore visible signs of struggle since respecting their independence means never offering unsolicited help

justification: Correct. Proactively checking in and offering support creates space for someone who may struggle to ask for help directly, reflecting genuinely supportive, observant leadership.

text: A project manager wants to determine the appropriate way to handle a situation where a team member consistently expresses discomfort with being the sole representative of their particular demographic group on the team. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Acknowledge their experience with empathy, and explore what support might help, such as connecting them with broader employee resource groups or networks if available within the organization
options.B: Dismiss their discomfort since diversity in team composition is generally positive regardless of individual experience
options.C: Require them to serve as the official spokesperson for their demographic group in all relevant discussions
options.D: Ignore the concern since being the only representative of a group is simply an unavoidable reality in smaller teams

justification: Correct. Acknowledging their experience empathetically and exploring available support, such as broader organizational networks, reflects genuine, supportive leadership that takes their expressed discomfort seriously.

text: A team member consistently expresses that they feel their contributions to architectural decisions are dismissed because they joined the team from a different technology background than the team's established stack. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Ignore the concern since technical stack familiarity naturally determines whose input matters most
options.B: Explicitly value diverse technical perspectives in architectural discussions, recognizing that experience with different technologies can offer valuable alternative approaches worth genuine consideration
options.C: Agree that only experience with the established stack should count in architectural discussions
options.D: Exclude them from architectural discussions until they have equivalent experience with the established stack

justification: Correct. Explicitly valuing diverse technical perspectives recognizes that different backgrounds can offer genuinely valuable alternative approaches, supporting a more inclusive and potentially more innovative architectural discussion.

text: A team's Scrum Master notices that team members frequently express frustration about a lack of clarity regarding how Sprint Backlog items should be reprioritized mid-Sprint when urgent needs arise. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Tell the team that Sprint Backlog items can never be changed under any circumstances once the Sprint begins
options.B: Assume the ambiguity is inherent to Scrum and cannot be clarified
options.C: Ignore the frustration since the team should figure this out informally over time
options.D: Facilitate a team discussion to explicitly establish a shared understanding of how mid-Sprint reprioritization should be handled, balancing protecting the Sprint Goal with accommodating genuine urgent needs

justification: Correct. Facilitating explicit clarification balancing Sprint Goal protection with genuine urgent need accommodation directly resolves the ambiguity, providing clear, shared understanding going forward.

text: A team member consistently expresses that they feel their contributions during code review are dismissed because their coding style differs from the team's dominant convention, even when their suggestions are technically sound. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Require them to adopt the dominant style completely before any of their feedback will be considered
options.B: Clarify the distinction between genuine style preferences (which may reasonably follow team convention) and substantive technical concerns (which should be evaluated on merit regardless of style differences)
options.C: Exclude them from code review discussions entirely since their style differs from the majority
options.D: Ignore the concern since coding style consistency should always override individual technical input

justification: Correct. Clarifying the distinction between style preference and substantive technical merit ensures genuinely sound suggestions are evaluated fairly, regardless of surface-level style differences.

text: A team member consistently expresses that they feel excluded from important decisions because they joined the team mid-project and missed the foundational discussions that shaped current practices. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Require the team to redo all foundational discussions from scratch simply because one new member missed them
options.B: Provide a thorough onboarding summary of key foundational decisions and their rationale, while ensuring their current input is genuinely valued in ongoing and future decisions
options.C: Exclude them from all future decisions since they missed the original foundational discussions
options.D: Tell them foundational context is unimportant since decisions have already been made

justification: Correct. Providing thorough onboarding context, while ensuring genuine value for their current input, addresses both the historical gap and their ongoing sense of inclusion in the team's decision-making.

text: Which of the following are appropriate ways to build psychological safety within a newly formed agile team? (Select TWO)

options.A: Modeling vulnerability by openly acknowledging one's own mistakes and uncertainties as a leader
options.B: Responding to mistakes and questions with curiosity and support rather than blame
options.C: Publicly criticizing any team member who raises a concern or asks a question
options.D: Punishing team members severely for any admitted uncertainty or mistake

justification: Correct. Modeling vulnerability as a leader by openly acknowledging mistakes and uncertainties directly builds psychological safety, showing the team it's safe to be honest and imperfect. / Correct. Responding with curiosity and support rather than blame reinforces a learning-oriented, safe environment where team members feel comfortable being honest.

text: A project manager wants to determine the appropriate way to handle a situation where a team member consistently expresses that they feel their non-traditional career path (e.g., self-taught, career changer) makes them feel like an outsider compared to more traditionally credentialed colleagues. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Explicitly recognize and value their demonstrated skills and contributions on their own merit, and address any specific instances of dismissive behavior related to their background directly
options.B: Suggest they pursue traditional credentials to feel more legitimately included
options.C: Ignore the concern since career path diversity is simply an unavoidable, unaddressable reality in most industries
options.D: Agree that traditional credentials are inherently more valuable than demonstrated skill and experience

justification: Correct. Explicitly recognizing and valuing demonstrated skills on their own merit, combined with addressing specific dismissive behaviors, directly counters the bias and supports a fair, inclusive team culture.

text: Match each type of inclusive leadership behavior to its correct example.

colonne_droite.texte: Repeating and crediting a quieter team member's idea that was initially overlooked in discussion
Advocating for a team member's advancement opportunity to senior leadership
Gently pointing out when a decision process may be unintentionally favoring one group over another
Using structured techniques to ensure all voices, not just the most vocal, are heard during discussions

justification: Amplification involves repeating and giving credit to a quieter team member's idea, ensuring it receives the recognition it deserves after being initially overlooked. / Active sponsorship involves actively advocating for a team member's career advancement, going beyond simple mentorship to using one's own influence on their behalf. / Bias interruption involves noticing and gently addressing situations where decision processes may be unintentionally favoring certain groups, promoting fairer outcomes. / Inclusive facilitation uses structured techniques to ensure balanced participation, preventing discussions from being dominated by only the most vocal participants.

text: A team wants to reduce the risk of a Sprint's Increment lacking adequate consideration of proper logging and monitoring for a new critical service, making future troubleshooting difficult. What is the BEST proactive practice?

options.A: Skip logging and monitoring consideration entirely to speed up initial delivery of the service
options.B: Address logging and monitoring gaps only after a production incident makes troubleshooting difficult
options.C: Incorporate appropriate logging and monitoring implementation as an explicit consideration in the Definition of Done for new critical services
options.D: Assume logging and monitoring can always be easily added later without any significant additional cost

justification: Correct. Explicitly incorporating logging and monitoring into the Definition of Done for critical services ensures this important operational consideration is proactively addressed, supporting future troubleshooting capability.

text: A team wants to reduce the risk of a Sprint's Increment lacking adequate consideration of data export functionality for users who need to migrate their data elsewhere. What is the BEST proactive practice?

options.A: Incorporate data export functionality as a genuine consideration in relevant backlog items, informed by actual user needs and, where applicable, data portability regulations
options.B: Skip data export functionality entirely since it might encourage users to leave the product
options.C: Address data export needs only after users specifically complain about being unable to migrate their data
options.D: Assume users will never need to export their data since the product is designed to be their primary tool

justification: Correct. Incorporating data export considerations based on actual user needs and applicable regulations (like data portability laws) reflects responsible, user-respecting product design.

text: A project manager needs to determine the appropriate way to handle a situation where a project's actual stakeholder engagement plan has become outdated due to significant organizational restructuring affecting several key stakeholders' roles. What is the BEST FIRST step?

options.A: Continue using the outdated stakeholder engagement plan without any review
options.B: Discard the entire stakeholder engagement plan and proceed with no formal stakeholder management approach
options.C: Ignore the restructuring since stakeholder plans are typically only reviewed at fixed, predetermined intervals
options.D: Review and update the stakeholder register and engagement plan to reflect the new organizational structure and any changed stakeholder roles or influence

justification: Correct. Reviewing and updating the stakeholder register and engagement plan to reflect the new structure is the appropriate response to a significant organizational change affecting stakeholder roles and influence.

text: A project manager needs to determine the appropriate way to handle a situation where a project's actual procurement cycle time has been significantly longer than planned, delaying critical material deliveries. What is the BEST way to investigate this?

options.A: Immediately bypass all procurement processes to expedite future material orders
options.B: Investigate the specific bottlenecks in the procurement cycle, which could include approval delays, vendor responsiveness, or process inefficiencies, before deciding on an appropriate corrective approach
options.C: Assume the procurement team is simply working too slowly without any further investigation
options.D: Ignore the delayed procurement cycle since procurement processes are entirely outside the project manager's influence

justification: Correct. Investigating specific bottlenecks such as approval delays or vendor responsiveness reflects proper root cause analysis, informing targeted, effective corrective action for the delayed procurement cycle.

text: Which of the following are valid techniques for improving the reliability of a project's schedule forecast? (Select TWO)

options.A: Regularly updating the schedule based on actual progress and reassessing remaining work
options.B: Using schedule reserve (buffer) to account for identified uncertainty in high-risk activities
options.C: Setting the schedule once and never updating it regardless of actual progress
options.D: Ignoring any variance between planned and actual progress

justification: Correct. Regularly updating the schedule based on actual progress and reassessing remaining work is fundamental to maintaining a reliable, evidence-based forecast. / Correct. Using schedule reserve for identified high-risk activities is a standard technique for improving forecast reliability by accounting for known uncertainty.

text: A team wants to reduce the risk of a Sprint's Increment lacking adequate consideration of concurrent user editing conflicts for a collaborative document feature. What is the BEST proactive practice?

options.A: Address concurrent editing conflicts only after users report data loss from simultaneous edits
options.B: Incorporate conflict resolution mechanisms (e.g., operational transformation, locking, or merge strategies) as an explicit design consideration for collaborative editing features
options.C: Assume only one user will ever edit a document at a time
options.D: Skip concurrent editing consideration entirely since it is considered too technically complex to address properly

justification: Correct. Incorporating conflict resolution mechanisms as an explicit design consideration directly addresses the core technical challenge inherent to genuinely collaborative editing features.

text: A project manager needs to determine the appropriate way to handle a situation where a project's actual training material update frequency has fallen significantly behind the pace of product changes, leading to outdated user documentation. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Establish a process to ensure documentation updates are tracked and prioritized alongside product changes, potentially incorporating documentation updates into the Definition of Done for relevant changes
options.B: Accept the outdated documentation as an unavoidable, unaddressable byproduct of rapid product development
options.C: Discontinue maintaining any user documentation entirely since it's difficult to keep current
options.D: Ignore the documentation gap since user documentation is generally considered less important than the actual product functionality

justification: Correct. Establishing a tracked, prioritized documentation update process, potentially integrated into the Definition of Done, directly addresses the root cause of documentation falling behind actual product changes.

text: A team wants to reduce the risk of a Sprint's Increment lacking adequate consideration of proper session timeout handling for a security-sensitive application. What is the BEST proactive practice?

options.A: Skip session timeout consideration entirely since it is considered a low-priority usability detail
options.B: Assume default session timeout settings from the underlying framework are always appropriate regardless of the application's specific security sensitivity
options.C: Address session timeout issues only after a security audit specifically flags the concern
options.D: Determine appropriate session timeout parameters based on the application's specific security sensitivity and relevant industry standards, incorporating this into the design and testing of relevant features

justification: Correct. Determining appropriate parameters based on actual security sensitivity and relevant standards, then incorporating this into design and testing, reflects responsible, proactive security consideration for a genuinely sensitive application.

text: A project manager needs to determine the appropriate way to handle a situation where a project's actual change request approval cycle time has been significantly longer than the target defined in the change management plan. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Ignore the extended cycle time since change approval delays are simply an unavoidable, unaddressable governance reality
options.B: Investigate the specific bottlenecks in the approval cycle, which could include unclear criteria, insufficient governance body availability, or process inefficiencies, before deciding on an appropriate response
options.C: Assume the target was simply unrealistic and immediately lower it without any investigation
options.D: Bypass the formal change approval process entirely to speed up future changes

justification: Correct. Investigating specific bottlenecks such as unclear criteria or governance availability reflects proper root cause analysis, informing targeted process improvements for the extended approval cycle.

text: Match each type of agile estimation technique to its correct description.

colonne_droite.texte: Team members simultaneously reveal numeric estimates to reduce anchoring bias
Using relative size categories (S, M, L, XL) for high-level, rough estimation
Grouping similar-sized items together on a spectrum without discussing each individually
Team members place a limited number of votes on items to indicate relative priority or size consensus

justification: Planning Poker has team members reveal numeric estimates simultaneously, reducing the anchoring bias that can occur when estimates are shared sequentially. / T-shirt sizing uses simple relative categories like S, M, L, XL for quick, high-level estimation, often useful for early-stage or large-scale prioritization. / Affinity estimating groups items of similar perceived size together along a spectrum quickly, without extensive individual discussion, useful for estimating many items efficiently. / Dot voting has team members place a limited number of votes on items, providing a quick way to gauge relative group consensus on priority or size.

text: A team wants to reduce the risk of a Sprint's Increment lacking adequate consideration of API versioning strategy as the product's API surface grows over time. What is the BEST proactive practice?

options.A: Skip versioning strategy entirely since it can always be figured out later without any issue
options.B: Assume the API will never need to change in breaking ways once initially released
options.C: Address versioning only after API consumers begin experiencing breaking changes without warning
options.D: Establish and document a clear API versioning strategy early, incorporating version considerations into the Definition of Done for relevant API-related backlog items

justification: Correct. Establishing a clear versioning strategy early and incorporating it into relevant work ensures the team has a consistent, well-understood approach for managing API evolution as the product grows.

text: A project manager needs to determine the appropriate way to handle a situation where a project's actual meeting minutes distribution has been inconsistent, with some stakeholders receiving them promptly and others not receiving them at all. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Ignore the inconsistency since meeting minutes are generally a minor administrative detail
options.B: Stop producing meeting minutes entirely since consistent distribution has proven difficult
options.C: Only provide meeting minutes to stakeholders who specifically request them each time
options.D: Establish and consistently follow a clear, defined distribution process for meeting minutes, ensuring all relevant stakeholders reliably receive them according to the communications management plan

justification: Correct. Establishing and consistently following a clear distribution process directly addresses the root cause of the inconsistency, ensuring reliable stakeholder communication per the communications plan.

text: A team wants to reduce the risk of a Sprint's Increment lacking adequate consideration of proper handling for users attempting to submit duplicate transactions (e.g., double-clicking a submit button). What is the BEST proactive practice?

options.A: Incorporate idempotency handling and duplicate submission prevention as an explicit consideration in the Definition of Done for relevant transactional features
options.B: Assume users will never accidentally trigger duplicate submissions
options.C: Skip duplicate submission handling entirely since it is considered a rare, unlikely edge case
options.D: Address duplicate submission issues only after users report being charged or processed multiple times

justification: Correct. Explicitly incorporating idempotency handling into the Definition of Done ensures this important, commonly needed transactional safety measure is consistently addressed.

text: A project manager needs to determine the appropriate way to handle a situation where a project's actual lessons learned repository has become so large and unstructured that team members find it difficult to locate relevant, useful information. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Implement a clear categorization and tagging system for the lessons learned repository, making it easier for team members to search for and find genuinely relevant information
options.B: Continue adding to the repository without any organizational structure or categorization
options.C: Delete the entire repository since it has become too difficult to navigate
options.D: Stop adding any new lessons learned entries since the existing repository is already too large

justification: Correct. Implementing clear categorization and tagging directly addresses the root cause of the navigability issue, making the valuable repository content genuinely more useful and accessible.

text: Which of the following are appropriate ways to handle a situation where a team's Sprint Backlog contains an item that, upon starting work, reveals significant undocumented complexity in the existing codebase? (Select TWO)

options.A: Transparently communicate the discovery to the team and Product Owner, discussing options such as splitting the item or adjusting the Sprint plan
options.B: Use the discovery as an opportunity to improve documentation of the previously undocumented complexity for future reference
options.C: Silently push through the complexity without informing anyone, regardless of the resulting time impact
options.D: Immediately abandon the item permanently without any further discussion or assessment

justification: Correct. Transparently communicating the discovery and discussing options like splitting or plan adjustment reflects Scrum's transparency principle and supports informed collaborative decision-making. / Correct. Using the discovery to improve documentation directly addresses the root cause (lack of documentation) and provides ongoing value for future work in that area of the codebase.

text: A project manager's organization is subject to a new mandatory food safety traceability requirement affecting a project involving packaged food product manufacturing. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Implement generic traceability practices without specifically verifying against the actual mandated requirements
options.B: Review the specific traceability requirements, assess gaps in current tracking systems, and incorporate necessary enhancements into the project plan with appropriate prioritization
options.C: Continue current traceability practices without any verification against the new mandatory requirement
options.D: Ignore the requirement since food safety traceability is considered purely a quality assurance department matter, not a project management concern

justification: Correct. Reviewing specific requirements, assessing gaps, and incorporating necessary enhancements reflects responsible, proactive integration of a legitimate and critically important new food safety requirement.

text: A project manager's organization is subject to a new mandatory renewable energy sourcing requirement affecting how the project's manufacturing facility must source its electricity. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Continue current energy sourcing practices without any verification against the new requirement
options.B: Assume the requirement will be automatically satisfied without any actual verification or planning
options.C: Ignore the requirement since energy sourcing is considered purely a facilities management matter, not a project management concern
options.D: Assess current energy sourcing against the new requirement, and incorporate necessary transition plans (e.g., renewable energy contracts, on-site generation) into the project plan

justification: Correct. Assessing current sourcing and incorporating necessary transition plans reflects responsible, proactive integration of a legitimate new environmental regulatory requirement into project planning.

text: An agile team's organization is exploring a shift toward supporting a 'bring your own device' (BYOD) policy for employee access to internal tools, requiring the product's security model to accommodate a wider variety of devices. What should the technical leader do FIRST?

options.A: Immediately implement BYOD support without assessing the security implications of a wider variety of potentially less-controlled devices
options.B: Refuse to support BYOD since it represents a departure from the current controlled-device access approach
options.C: Assess the security implications of BYOD access, including device management and data protection considerations, before committing significant backlog investment in supporting this access model
options.D: Assume BYOD devices carry identical security risk profiles to the organization's currently managed devices

justification: Correct. Assessing security implications, including device management and data protection, before major investment reflects responsible, evidence-based evaluation of an access model with genuine security considerations.

text: An agile team's organization is exploring a shift toward supporting a customer data trust/vault model, giving customers direct control over which third parties can access their data through the platform. What should the product leader do FIRST?

options.A: Immediately build comprehensive data control features without researching applicable data governance regulations or actual customer demand for this level of control
options.B: Research applicable data governance regulations and validate genuine customer demand for granular data control before committing significant backlog investment
options.C: Refuse to explore the idea since it represents a significant departure from the current data handling approach
options.D: Assume all customers want maximum granular control over their data without any actual research into customer preferences

justification: Correct. Researching applicable regulations and validating genuine demand before major investment reflects responsible, evidence-based evaluation of a feature with real regulatory and user experience implications.

text: An agile team's organization is exploring a shift toward supporting a 'digital twin' feature for physical products the company sells, creating a virtual representation for monitoring and simulation purposes. What should the product leader do FIRST?

options.A: Immediately build comprehensive digital twin functionality without researching technical feasibility or actual customer value proposition
options.B: Refuse to explore the idea since it represents a significant technical departure from the current product's digital-only functionality
options.C: Research technical feasibility, required sensor/data infrastructure, and validate genuine customer value proposition before committing significant backlog investment
options.D: Assume digital twin implementation will be straightforward without any technical assessment

justification: Correct. Researching technical feasibility, required infrastructure, and validating genuine customer value before major investment reflects responsible, evidence-based evaluation of a technically complex and potentially high-value new capability.

text: A team member consistently expresses that they feel their input during retrospectives is only acted upon when it aligns with what the Scrum Master already believed needed to change. What is the BEST way for the Scrum Master to address this?

options.A: Stop facilitating retrospectives entirely to avoid this recurring perception
options.B: Tell the team member their perception is simply inaccurate without further reflection
options.C: Dismiss the concern since the Scrum Master's judgment about priorities is generally sound
options.D: Reflect on how action items are actually selected, and make the selection process more transparent and collaborative, ensuring the team genuinely drives which improvements get pursued

justification: Correct. Reflecting on and making the action item selection process more transparent and collaborative directly addresses the concern, ensuring genuine team ownership of improvement priorities.

text: A team member consistently expresses that they feel their contributions during sprint reviews are minimized because a more senior colleague tends to speak on their behalf before they can present their own work. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Accept the current dynamic since the senior colleague likely has good intentions
options.B: Tell the affected team member to simply speak louder or interrupt to be heard
options.C: Exclude the senior colleague from all future sprint reviews to prevent the pattern
options.D: Have a private conversation with the senior colleague about allowing each team member to present their own work, while also ensuring the affected team member has explicit space to share their contributions directly

justification: Correct. A private conversation with the senior colleague about allowing individual presentation, combined with ensuring explicit space for the affected team member, directly addresses the dynamic constructively.

text: A team member consistently expresses that they feel overlooked for interesting or challenging assignments, receiving mostly routine tasks despite expressing interest in growth opportunities. What is the BEST way for the project leader to address this?

options.A: Ignore the concern since task assignment should be based purely on immediate delivery efficiency
options.B: Assign them only the most challenging tasks going forward regardless of their actual current skill level
options.C: Continue the current assignment pattern since it has been working adequately from a delivery perspective
options.D: Review task assignment patterns and make a deliberate effort to provide them with appropriately challenging opportunities aligned with their expressed growth interests

justification: Correct. Reviewing assignment patterns and deliberately providing appropriately challenging opportunities directly addresses their expressed interest in growth while supporting their development.

text: A team member consistently expresses that they feel their contributions are undervalued because they often work on cross-team coordination tasks that don't map cleanly to the team's own Sprint metrics. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Ignore the concern since coordination work is a necessary role regardless of how it's perceived
options.B: Make the value of their cross-team coordination work explicitly visible, connecting it to concrete outcomes like reduced cross-team delays or improved integration success
options.C: Reassign them exclusively to work that maps cleanly to Sprint metrics regardless of the team's actual cross-team coordination needs
options.D: Dismiss their concern since work that doesn't map to Sprint metrics is inherently less valuable

justification: Correct. Making the coordination work's value explicitly visible by connecting it to concrete outcomes directly addresses the recognition gap while preserving the value of this essential, often under-recognized work.

text: A project manager wants to determine the appropriate way to handle a situation where a team member consistently expresses that they feel their contributions during vendor negotiations are dismissed because they lack formal procurement training, despite having relevant subject matter expertise. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Agree that only those with formal procurement training should participate meaningfully in vendor negotiations
options.B: Exclude them from vendor negotiations entirely until they obtain formal procurement training
options.C: Ignore the concern since procurement expertise should always take precedence over subject matter expertise in negotiations
options.D: Ensure their subject matter expertise is genuinely valued and incorporated into negotiations, while pairing them with procurement-trained colleagues to combine complementary expertise

justification: Correct. Ensuring their subject matter expertise is genuinely valued while pairing them with procurement-trained colleagues combines complementary strengths, supporting more effective, inclusive negotiations.

text: A project manager wants to determine the appropriate way to handle a situation where a team member consistently expresses that they feel their contributions during client presentations are minimized because English is not their first language, despite strong technical content. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Provide practical support such as presentation coaching, allow additional preparation time, and ensure clients focus on the strong technical substance of their contributions rather than accent or minor language differences
options.B: Exclude them from client presentations entirely to avoid any potential communication challenges
options.C: Dismiss their concern since language differences are simply an unavoidable, unaddressable reality in global business
options.D: Require them to significantly alter their natural speaking style to sound more like native speakers before presenting

justification: Correct. Providing practical support like coaching and preparation time, combined with reinforcing focus on their strong technical substance, respects their genuine contribution while offering constructive assistance.

text: A project manager wants to determine the appropriate way to handle a situation where a team member consistently expresses that they feel excluded from key decisions because those decisions are frequently made during informal conversations outside scheduled meetings. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Ignore the concern since informal decision-making is a normal, unavoidable part of any workplace

options.C: Ban all informal conversations between team members entirely to eliminate any possibility of exclusionary decision-making
options.D: Establish a practice of formally documenting and sharing any decisions made informally, ensuring all relevant team members are kept informed regardless of whether they were part of the original informal conversation

justification: Correct. Establishing a formal documentation and sharing practice for informally made decisions ensures all relevant team members stay informed, directly addressing the exclusion concern without eliminating natural workplace interaction.

text: A project manager wants to determine the appropriate way to handle a situation where a team member consistently expresses that they feel their contributions to risk identification are dismissed because they tend to raise concerns others perceive as overly cautious. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Ignore the concern since risk perspectives that differ from the majority are generally not worth taking seriously

options.D: Exclude them from risk identification discussions entirely since their perspective differs from the majority

justification: Correct. Reinforcing the genuine value of diverse risk perspectives, while helping frame concerns constructively, addresses both the substantive value of their input and how it's received by the team.

text: Which of the following are appropriate ways to support a team member returning from a period of extended medical leave? (Select TWO)

options.A: Provide a gradual ramp-up of responsibilities based on their own comfort and any relevant medical guidance
options.B: Have a supportive, private conversation about any accommodations they may need, letting them lead the discussion of what to share
options.C: Require them to immediately resume their full pre-leave workload regardless of any actual readiness
options.D: Publicly announce details of their medical situation to the team without their consent

justification: Correct. Providing a gradual ramp-up based on their comfort and relevant guidance reflects supportive, appropriate reintegration for someone returning from extended medical leave. / Correct. A supportive, private conversation that lets them lead the discussion respects their autonomy and privacy while genuinely offering appropriate support.

text: A project manager notices that a highly capable team member has become increasingly withdrawn over the past several weeks, missing informal social interactions, providing minimal input in meetings, and submitting work that, while still competent, lacks their previous creative flair. No formal performance issue has been raised, and the team member has not mentioned anything is wrong. What is the BEST way for the project manager to approach this situation?

options.A: Wait until a formal performance issue emerges before taking any action, since no explicit problem has been raised

options.C: Address the pattern publicly during a team meeting to signal that engagement levels are being monitored
options.D: Assume the changes reflect a lack of commitment to the project and immediately reduce their responsibilities

justification: Correct. A private, caring check-in that expresses observations without judgment, creates space for sharing, and offers support resources reflects genuinely supportive, observant leadership appropriate for noticing concerning changes in a valued team member without requiring them to disclose anything they're not ready to share.

text: A team wants to reduce the risk of a Sprint's Increment lacking adequate consideration of proper handling for expired or revoked authentication tokens. What is the BEST proactive practice?

options.A: Assume authentication tokens will never expire or need revocation during normal use
options.B: Incorporate token expiration and revocation handling as an explicit consideration in the Definition of Done for features involving authentication
options.C: Address token handling issues only after users report being unexpectedly logged out or experiencing access errors
options.D: Skip token lifecycle consideration entirely since it is considered a low-priority security detail

text: A team wants to reduce the risk of a Sprint's Increment lacking adequate consideration of proper handling for network timeout scenarios in a mobile application. What is the BEST proactive practice?

options.A: Incorporate network timeout handling and appropriate user feedback (e.g., retry options, clear error messages) as an explicit consideration in relevant backlog items for the mobile application

text: A project manager needs to determine the appropriate way to handle a situation where a project's actual vendor performance evaluation scores have been consistently declining across multiple evaluation periods. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Investigate the specific reasons behind the consistent decline, engage the vendor in a collaborative discussion about improvement, and consider contractual remedies if warranted based on the actual findings

options.C: Immediately terminate the vendor contract without any investigation or improvement discussion
options.D: Ignore the declining scores since vendor performance naturally fluctuates over time

justification: Correct. Investigating the specific causes, engaging the vendor collaboratively, and considering contractual remedies based on actual findings reflects proper, evidence-based vendor performance management.

text: A project manager needs to determine the appropriate way to handle a situation where a project's actual document approval turnaround time has been inconsistent across different types of documents, with no clear pattern explaining the variation. What is the BEST way to investigate this?

options.A: Analyze the specific approval workflows for different document types to identify whether varying complexity, approver availability, or process differences explain the inconsistency

options.C: Assume the inconsistency is simply random and cannot be meaningfully analyzed
options.D: Establish a single, identical approval process for all document types regardless of their actual differing complexity or requirements

justification: Correct. Analyzing specific approval workflows for different document types can reveal genuine explanatory factors like complexity or approver availability, informing targeted process improvements.

text: A team wants to reduce the risk of a Sprint's Increment lacking adequate consideration of proper handling for large file uploads that could time out or fail partway through. What is the BEST proactive practice?

options.A: Assume all file uploads will always complete successfully without any interruption

options.D: Skip large file upload resilience consideration entirely since it is considered a rare edge case

justification: Correct. Incorporating resumable upload handling or clear failure/retry mechanisms directly addresses the genuine risk of interruption for large file uploads, a standard consideration for this type of feature.

text: Which of the following are valid techniques for validating that a project's risk register remains current and relevant throughout the project lifecycle? (Select TWO)

options.A: Conducting periodic risk reviews or reassessments at defined intervals or trigger points
options.B: Encouraging ongoing risk identification from team members throughout project execution, not just at planning

text: An agile team's organization is exploring a shift toward supporting a customer advisory board to gather ongoing strategic input from key customers. What should the product leader do to prepare for effective use of this input?

options.D: Establish a clear process for capturing, evaluating, and appropriately incorporating advisory board input into backlog prioritization, balanced against other business priorities and evidence

justification: Correct. Establishing a clear process for capturing and appropriately evaluating advisory board input, balanced against other priorities and evidence, reflects thoughtful, evidence-based integration of this valuable but non-exclusive input source.

text: An agile team's organization is exploring a shift toward supporting a bug bounty program to crowdsource security vulnerability discovery. What should the technical/product leader do FIRST?

options.A: Establish clear program scope, reward structure, and vulnerability response processes, potentially consulting with security experts, before launching the program

justification: Correct. Establishing clear program parameters and response processes, potentially with expert consultation, before launching reflects responsible, well-prepared evaluation of a legitimate but operationally complex security initiative.

text: An agile team's organization is exploring a shift toward supporting API rate plan tiers (e.g., free, professional, enterprise) with differing usage limits for third-party developers. What should the product leader do FIRST?

options.A: Ignore the idea since it deviates from the current single-tier API access approach

options.D: Immediately implement comprehensive tiered rate plans without researching actual developer usage patterns or competitive tier structures

text: A project manager's organization is subject to a new mandatory critical minerals supply chain resilience requirement affecting sourcing decisions for a manufacturing project. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Continue current sourcing practices without any verification against the new resilience requirement
options.B: Ignore the requirement since supply chain resilience is considered purely a procurement department matter, not a project management concern

options.D: Work with procurement to assess supply chain resilience against the new requirement, and incorporate necessary diversification or contingency planning into the project's sourcing strategy

text: Match each type of ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance) consideration to its correct example in a project context.

colonne_droite.texte: Reducing a manufacturing project's carbon emissions and waste output
Ensuring fair labor practices and safe working conditions for project workers
Maintaining transparent, ethical decision-making processes and accountability structures
Identifying which ESG factors are most significant and relevant to a specific project or organization

justification: Environmental considerations focus on a project's ecological impact, such as emissions, waste, and resource consumption. / Social considerations focus on the human impact of a project, including labor practices, worker safety, and community relations. / Governance considerations focus on ethical, transparent decision-making processes and accountability structures within the project and organization. / A materiality assessment identifies which specific ESG factors are most significant and relevant to a particular project or organization, guiding where to focus ESG efforts.

text: Match each type of project constraint to its correct example.

colonne_droite.texte: A fixed set of required deliverables that cannot be reduced without stakeholder approval
A mandatory regulatory deadline that cannot be extended
A fixed, non-negotiable budget ceiling set by the funding organization
A limited pool of specialized personnel available for the project

justification: A scope constraint fixes the required deliverables, meaning any reduction requires formal stakeholder approval through change control. / A schedule constraint, such as a mandatory regulatory deadline, fixes the timeline with little to no flexibility for extension. / A cost constraint sets a fixed, non-negotiable budget ceiling that the project must operate within. / A resource constraint limits the availability of specific needed resources, such as specialized personnel, affecting how work can be scheduled and executed.

text: A project manager's organization is subject to a new mandatory product safety recall notification requirement affecting how the project's manufactured product must handle future safety issues. What is the BEST way to address this for the current project?

options.C: Ignore the requirement since recall notification is considered purely a legal/compliance department matter, not a project management concern
options.D: Assume current processes already satisfy the notification requirement without any actual verification

justification: Correct. Reviewing specific requirements, assessing process gaps, and incorporating necessary enhancements reflects responsible, proactive integration of a legitimate and critically important new product safety requirement.

text: A project manager's organization is subject to a new mandatory export documentation retention requirement affecting how the project's international shipping records must be maintained. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Review the specific retention requirements, assess gaps in current documentation practices, and establish appropriate record-keeping processes to ensure ongoing compliance
options.B: Ignore the requirement since documentation retention is considered purely an administrative matter, not a project management concern
options.C: Retain all documentation indefinitely by default without any specific process aligned to the actual requirement
options.D: Continue current documentation practices without any verification against the new retention requirement

justification: Correct. Reviewing specific requirements, assessing gaps, and establishing appropriate processes reflects responsible, proactive integration of a legitimate new compliance requirement into project record-keeping.

text: An agile team's organization is exploring a shift toward supporting a customer-facing sustainability dashboard showing the environmental impact of their product usage. What should the product leader do FIRST?

options.A: Ignore the idea since it deviates from the product's current core functionality
options.B: Ensure any displayed environmental impact data is based on verified, accurate methodology before committing significant backlog investment, avoiding potential greenwashing concerns

options.D: Assume customers won't scrutinize the accuracy of displayed sustainability figures

text: An agile team's organization is exploring a shift toward supporting a customer co-creation program where select customers can directly propose and vote on upcoming feature priorities. What should the product leader do FIRST?

options.A: Ignore the idea since customer co-creation represents a significant departure from the current internally-driven prioritization approach

text: A project manager's organization is subject to a new mandatory single-use plastics reduction requirement affecting the packaging design for a manufactured product project. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Ignore the requirement since packaging design is considered purely a marketing/branding matter, not a project management concern

text: A project manager's organization is subject to a new mandatory water usage disclosure requirement affecting a manufacturing project's operational reporting. What is the BEST way to address this?

options.A: Assess current water usage tracking capability against the new disclosure requirement, and implement necessary monitoring and reporting enhancements
options.B: Ignore the requirement since water usage disclosure is considered purely an environmental compliance department matter, not a project management concern

text: An agile team's organization is exploring a shift toward supporting a customer data anonymization service as a premium feature for privacy-conscious enterprise clients. What should the product leader do FIRST?

options.A: Research applicable data protection standards and validate genuine enterprise client demand for this specific capability before committing significant backlog investment
options.B: Refuse to explore the idea since it represents a significant departure from the current product's core functionality
options.C: Assume anonymization techniques used elsewhere in the industry will be automatically adequate for this specific product's data types without any evaluation

text: An agile team's organization is preparing to launch a healthcare-adjacent wellness feature in three markets simultaneously: one with strict health data regulations similar to HIPAA, one with general data privacy laws only, and one with no specific health data regulations currently in place. The Product Owner wants a single, unified feature launch across all three markets on the same date to simplify marketing. What is the BEST way for the product leader to approach this?

options.A: Launch the identical feature simultaneously in all three markets using only the most lenient market's requirements as the baseline
options.B: Launch different feature versions with completely different codebases for each market without any shared compliance baseline
options.C: Delay the launch in the strictest market indefinitely while proceeding immediately in the other two, regardless of marketing preferences
options.D: Design the feature to meet the strictest applicable regulatory standard (the HIPAA-like market) as the baseline for all markets, ensuring compliance everywhere while still allowing a unified launch date, and consult legal experts to confirm this approach

justification: Correct. Designing to meet the strictest applicable standard as a baseline, confirmed with legal experts, ensures compliance across all markets while still enabling the desired unified launch date, reflecting responsible, evidence-based handling of a genuinely complex multi-jurisdictional regulatory situation.
